body.text: I am sure you have heard the word poltergeist. In the paranormal world, this is one kind of entity you must never provoke. And most of you must have a working idea about what it basically means. No? Okay! Well, then buckle up, because this is going to be a ride. In this excerpt, we will understand poltergeist meaning and why is it important to stay away from them.
Meaning of a Poltergeist

The meaning of word Poltergeist signifies a ghost that is noisy. This essentially means that a poltergeist is someone who has the ability to move certain objects and do all sorts of things involving misplacement. All this is aggressive in nature in the paranormal universe. They are a type of ghost most people are scared of since they can physically hurt you by moving things. People also end up getting hurt due to the shock they feel after watching their things get displaced.

There is a sense of belief among a lot of people that a poltergeist is found around teenagers, especially teenage girls. Then there are those who believe that poltergeists are found around basically anyone with unconcluded emotional problems. However, there is a general consensus among people that poltergeists cling to negative people and entities.

I believe in everything above but I would like to add more to it. My experience has shown me that whenever I’ve been in closer proximity to a poltergeist, there has been a very heavy concentration of energy present. This energy can be anger, revolt, sadness, etc. This energy is too much to contain and it sometimes bursts only to turn the atmosphere negative.
Negative Entities are Drawn Towards Negative Feelings

One thing in common with most of the ghosts or such supernatural entities is that the more negative they are, the more they are drawn towards these evil and negative feelings. For a ghost who is just travelling through space and time, these kinds of emotions or feelings are too much to handle so they prefer to stay away. Therefore, negative paranormal activity is always proportional to negative emotions.

Even if the ghost is drawn towards such an energy, it might not know how to tackle or play with the opportunity. But, for a demon, this is the perfect opportunity to pronounce. They are always on the lookout for such an opportunity and they like to feed on people who are feeling these sort of emotions. Their main aim during this time is to create maximum fear and anxiety among their prey.

Hence, you might notice things and objects moving erratically, things being thrown, loud noises and even ominous growls. Also, there is a risk of coming under attacks that are physical in nature. The thing to note here is that it all depends upon how destructive the paranormal entity wants to be.
My first poltergeist experience

Let me tell you a story about my first poltergeist experience. I was 10 years old. My family had just shifted to a new place. The house was kind of old but it was well kept. My friend who visited me regularly was a psychic and he always acted strange when he entered my house. I remember the first time when he came to my new house, his face suddenly changed when he saw the door open.

He was always reluctant to come to my house. Later, when we left the house, we came to know from one of our old neighbours that the house was haunted. Then I remembered all those instances of doors bashing and the voices calling my name. I also remember one summer night, I was asleep. Suddenly I woke up in the middle of the night to see my tape recorder switched on and frequencies of the FM radio changing on their own. I was really scared that night. So, Yes…sometimes these strange events happen.
My Advice – Stay Away

My next poltergeist experience happened when I was around 17 years old. It was a different house – that of my classmate but had rampant paranormal activity. I used to study late at night for my board exams. It was around 4 AM when I saw a shadow pass through the door of my room and then the door closing by itself. I felt a very strong sense of negativity and a chill ran through my spine. This continued to happen a few more times. Sometimes, it was the noise and sometimes I woke up at night only to see my study table shaking. It was surreal and I pray no one has to go through that.

My life during those days was very downcast. The feeling of evil and negativity was like a plague that just multiplied in that house. There was anxiety, confusion, and a sense of dejection among all of us in the house. And the funniest part is that we all thought it was due to the excessive stress on account of our board exams. It was a really tough time. In such a situation things could have gotten worse. I still believe that there was someone, a higher power or authority who was protecting me from evil and that is the reason why there was no physical damage rendered to me or to my classmate/friends family.
To Conclude

When I look back, I realize that the attempt by negatives to scare or dishearten me from using my gift was foiled away by someone who was protecting me and keeping me away from evil. It might be the divine forces I pry upon or an angel or it might be my guiding spirits. I am not sure. Summing up, what I have seen and known about a poltergeist is that they are someone who has the ability to displace physical objects and that they are drawn towards people who are vulnerable. They feed on the weak and are in search of souls that can be scared and manipulated. The more scared you get the stronger they become. Also, they like to destroy or mess with your belongings. Now you know the meaning of poltergeist and why you should stay away. Over the last 25 years, I’ve had many experiences with poltergeists, but I exactly know how to handle these situations. And if you are not trained, I suggest you back off.

We have a whole team of divine helpers looking out for us, including spirits and spirit guides. Spirits are souls that have passed on to the afterlife in a relatively typical fashion. They are not tied down to a single place of thing. Since they vibrate at a much higher frequency than other paranormal beings, they need substantially greater energy to manifest in the material world.

How do you know that Spirit Guides are watching over you?

Several times in my paranormal expeditions, I have gotten into circumstances that were uncomfortable, to say the least. Rescuing me from all my mess-ups have been this positive spiritual energy. Much to my relief, they’ve always known when to intervene in some form or fashion. At one instance, I had one levitate me off the chair. I know for a sceptic, this may sound amusing, but just stick with me, and you’ll know. Immediately following the levitation, I felt as if whatever cynical that was happening before abruptly stopped.

It’s improbable that you will see your spirit guides, but you indeed will feel them. Sometimes, if they want, you can hear them as well. Instantly you will get a feeling of warmth as if something or someone is blocking out all the negativity from you. You will feel comforted. If you want to connect with your spirit guide, permit them to protect you, and they most definitely will signal their presence. It can be a sudden warmth, comfort, or something that is very intimate. It’s easier for spirit guides to work with feelings and sensations. Don’t expect that they’ll appear before you suddenly – they can’t.
Spirits vs. Ghosts

There’s a big difference between a Spirit (those who have transitioned) and a Ghost (those who have not). A ghost depends on Earthly energy to stay here. A Spirit has their own supply of energy from the other side. Since the energy of a Ghost is denser, they are mostly earth-bound. In contrast, spirits have passed onto the higher realms.

Ghosts can easily bang utensils, move chairs, throw things because it does not take them much effort. Spirits can do the same things as well, but it requires them much more energy because they vibrate at a higher frequency. Therefore, they don’t do it nearly as much as ghosts do. This is why you’ll hear and see a ghost much more easily than you’ll ever hear or see a spirit.
How do you know it’s a Spirit and not a Ghost?

If you feel sudden goosebumps and a chilling cold sweeping down your spine, yes, it’s a ghost. We have already established that spirit guides make you feel warm and comforted. You’ll catch sight of ghost apparitions all the time, but spirits only appear as orbs or smoky wisps. So can a spirit guide drain batteries and flicker the lights? Yes, they can. But if you hear a voice caught on EVP, it is most likely a ghost – a big thing for a paranormal expert. You can listen to your spirit guide, but you can never record their voice.

body.text: My understanding of a ghost in the paranormal arena is different from what many of you see in movies. It stems from my years of contact with them, where I practically lived with ghosts for a considerable part of my life. Ever since then, I have had many encounters, and it has shaped my understanding of them significantly.

What do you think a ghost is? Is it just a feeling, is it real, or is it something that people say, “it’s all in your head?” Before we proceed to a detailed understanding of the thing that we call a ghost, here is one thing that I want to clear – Ghosts are real, and there are no two ways about it.

Moving on, the first time when I experienced something that I couldn’t explain was when I was five. I used to live in my grandparents’ house, during vacations back in our small village. The house had a character of its own with a grand and ancient entrance and many closets – the one that you see and get a feeling that it is haunted.
My childhood has been marked by several encounters, most of which left me scared to the bones. With time I learned how to live with it and switch it off, the fear, for hours at a stretch.

With time and experience, I have realized that one this is certain – we cannot define ghosts like we define convex and concave lenses. No one knows for sure what a Ghost is; there is no one concrete definition. Everything about the paranormal is theoretical, and there are many theories to explain the experiences that people from around the globe have.
What do you mean by the term Ghost?

In the most simple terms of paranormal – ghosts are souls that have no body. They are people who have left their bodily abode but refuse to leave the earth. The reason can be numerous; the soul might be stuck because of some past trauma. They might not have achieved their purpose or attached to things, people, and places. Or sometimes they are just lost and confused, hence just not wanting to leave the site.

Just imagine, it is the usual sunny morning, you are driving to work, and then you meet with an accident. You were not ready for that, right? It will take some time to realize and process that you are gone and more time to accept and adjust, especially since you did not wish to go just yet. These ghosts are stuck in a limbo state – when they haunt the location or place of their death or ones that they admired during their life. These types of ghosts are not aware of their surroundings or human beings. They are stuck doing things they did when they were living, breathing soul.

“A soldier has been witnessed on multiple repeated occasions staring out a tower where he once stood guard. A child’s footstep is apparent in the corridors of an abandoned home. There have also been instances of ghost trains that are heard and sometimes seen on places where the tracks existed once.” Most of the encounters that human beings have are with such ghosts only. In contrast, there are souls who want to stay, well, because it’s their choice. They simply like it here and just don’t want to leave. Others are here to seek revenge and get things even. Those are the ones we need to watch out for!
How do Ghosts Stay Alive – in their World?

We already know that ghosts have nobody, and trust me when I say that it is not an inconvenience. With enough energy, ghosts have an extraordinary power to overcome the disadvantage of not having a body. Ghosts can be friendly, sad, angry, stuck, volatile, confused, stubborn, mean, and what not! All of them live off energy, which also includes energy assimilated from human beings.

In order to stay alive without a body, a ghost needs to derive and feed on energy. Failing to do so, they will eventually fade and get absorbed fully. Ghosts derive their energy from many places and numerous things. That energy can be derived from fellow ghosts who are frightened or fragile.

New ghosts still have a lot of energy from when they are alive. This energy of the paranormal is a source of attraction for the older ghosts who feed on that as well. Have you seen the flickering lights and drained batteries in horror movies? Well, it’s because ghosts can influence light and electricity to get that energy, too.
How do human beings become a source of energy for ghosts?

Human beings are one of the best sources of energy because of their emotions. These emotions create a lot of energy, which the ghosts feed on. Now when we are happy, sad, stressed, or angry, we refract a lot of energy. The heavier the emotion is, the denser the energy.

Just think don’t you feel carefree and light when you are happy? But you feel irritated, dense, and heavy when you are angry, scared, or stressed. For a ghost, the latter is like their dream dessert. That is why you feel a presence more when you are afraid, and that is why I felt all those things very early on in life. However, I have learned to switch off the fear that is for another blog. Don’t want to see a ghost? Be happy then!
To Conclude

So, are ghosts something real? Yes, they are in the paranormal world. If you experience something out of the ordinary, no, it’s not in your head. It is a profound, authentic, and every-going mystery that we will take some time to unearth.

To summarize, a ghost is nothing more than a human soul who is either stuck here, confused and lost, or has chosen to stay. They usually will not hurt you, but they can if they’re volatile enough. Mostly, if you can tone down the fear, you feel you’re more than half the way home of getting rid of them.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence a good paranormal investigator should advise his clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Most of your clients may feel desperate due to whatever they are going through. It’s your duty to act responsibly. Guide them through the path of modern science. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.

If you tick all these boxes or most of them, you might seriously need to consult a paranormal investigator in India.

These haunting signs are in the same order as most of us experienced them when we grew up. Before we were fully exposed to this arena, these things have always remained quite frightening for us as well. As you are aware by now we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
Signs of Haunting – Whispering

Whispering is among the first signs of hauntings, and it was true in my case too. Whispering voices were the first introduction I had to the spirit world. Then again, these voices are not intelligent ghosts who can communicate clearly. They are mostly muffled voices that make no sense whatsoever. At this juncture, it is important to clarify that voices come much later on in a haunting. Besides, that’s proven to usually not be the case at all.

The sounds feel like coming from different people. It is quite distinct in that sense. Understand that it is distinctive in terms of someone (or more) whispering but not in terms of what they are whispering. The conversation feels fast-paced. You can make out that, presumably via tone and inflection. Yet, it can go on for several seconds and minutes. Therefore, from my experience whisperings are totally unmistakable haunting signs.
Physical sensations

Often physical sensations follow whispering as one of the signs of haunting activity. And I have been experiencing them a lot across my career in the paranormal arena. When you get into their space, It feels as though someone is watching you at all times. The feeling that makes chills run down the spine. You may feel a presence behind you. As if someone is standing behind your back and looking over your shoulder.
Signs of Haunting – Manifestation

Manifestation happens when a ghost or spirit presents itself before a human being. This is, in essence, the meaning of manifestation. Now that you have a basic idea of what manifestation meaning is, let us discuss, how can a ghost manifest. The universe is physical in nature and matter is all around us. For a ghost or a spirit to manifest, it must have a lot of energy. The energy has to be dense and high in order for the spirit to manifest itself in a heavier form. This is the reason why manifestation is really uncommon. The energy required for this is immense and it does not happen regularly. Or rather most entities do not have the requisite energies in them to manifest.

The energy I am talking about in the above paragraph is emitted from multiple sources. So, there are different sources of energy involved in this. To collect the energy from so many sources becomes really difficult as the availability is less in most cases. However, energy from humans, water, and batteries are sometimes available. The energy can also come from a source that is electrical in nature. We know that electricity has a lot of energy on offer and a spirit might use the energy to manifest itself. To subject that energy into becoming something apparent also requires a lot of energy hence it becomes really difficult to see a spirit fully manifest itself. This is why manifestation is extremely rare.
The Reaction of Your Pet

Another of the big signs of haunting activity is the reaction of your pets. Pets, in this case, are a lot like children, obviously can’t just dismiss something as “not real” simply because you say it isn’t. Plus, they too are just so innocent that they tap in without meaning to. For us humans, the dog whistle is so out of our frequency range that we hear nothing. Yet, the pet reacts immediately and strongly. Scientifically we know they smell, hear, and see better than we do. Now, we only need to accept that everything they see, hear, and sense doesn’t have to be in the same realm as we operate in either.

And, it’s just downright creepy! Still, as I mentioned earlier, check the floors. Also, make sure there’s not too much pressure from either the door latch itself or from a too-tight fit that stresses the hinges.
Signs of Haunting – Electrical Equipment Behaving Haphazardly

In addition to my closet doors being open, during that exact same time period my record player was also always blaring every single time it happened. I have mentioned before that psychic energy travels on nearly the same frequency or wavelength as electricity. This makes it easy to understand why spirits can manipulate electricity so easily. It’s like gas to a car. They need it to do what they want to do, and it’s likely even more familiar to them than it is to us. Therefore, when you experience a lot of electrical appliances malfunctioning or operating in strange ways, I’d pay attention. I’d also pay attention if you have frequent light bulbs burning out or bursting. Naturally, you’ll want to have your wiring checked by a professional immediately. But, if they find no electrical problem or reason for it, know that ghosts or spirits easily can influence all things electronic.
Smells

One of the major signs of haunting activity is ghost smells. The smell is one of the easiest and most powerful ways for a ghost to communicate with us. Although this wasn’t the first thing that I noticed in my paranormal experience, it was very prominent. However, at this moment, it is very common for me to experience smells. In fact, it’s often one of the most obvious and frequent manifestations many report experiencing. Today, when I’m working with a client I often smell cigars, perfumes, favourite flowers, and even flowers that represent the spirit’s name who is trying to get through.

Ghosts can and do often manifest smells in much the same way spirits can. This is why this is also among the signs of haunting activity. Therefore, if you’re trying to discern if there’s a ghost in your house, try to avoid wearing cologne till you notice a pattern. Instead, take down the smell volume by even turning off scent dispensers. Also, don’t spray room freshener, smoke, wear anything with too much fabric softener smell, or even use breathy mints or suck on lozenges. Most definitely, don’t cook anything. In other words, make your house smell as bland as it possibly can for a night or two. That way, you can start from a clean slate in order to detect the smell.
Signs of Haunting – Being Held Down in Your Bed

I’ve had this experience a few times. And, I can tell you that you will never ever want to experience it again. Let me begin by saying unequivocally, this was not sleep paralysis as some might label it. In my mind, you should never just blanket-statement anything in the paranormal field, because each and every incident is individual. Paranormal means that there are no reliable or hard and fast rules. We must remember that. Evaluate each situation individually. You’ll miss valuable information when you don’t do this.
Signs of Haunting – Orbs

An orb is also known as a ball of light as it has a glow in it and is in a spherical shape. People believe that orbs contain the energy of the people who have died and are basically the remnants of what the person used to be. Meanwhile, the cynics are of the belief that they are nothing but particles of dust and dirt. Both the cynics and the believers have different and polarised opinions when it comes to orbs. Then there are the ones whose beliefs are in between the two. Orbs are not always important in paranormal terms. It can be just dirt, dust, or smoke in the surrounding area. But when it is observable by naked eyes then it becomes a thing of intrigue.

An orb is usually regarded as a CPC (close proximity contamination) and usually is found in close proximity to the camera. CPC is nothing but elements that are found in our surroundings. These elements tend to adulterate the lens and are visible in the field of view of the lens. It includes raindrops, water, moisture, dust, dirt, wool, skin, fibers, insects, spiderwebs, hair, etc.

Therefore, at that time, ectoplasm, in the eyes of a paranormal expert, did not have much value.

Therefore, because of this, many people were of the opinion that it was fake, thereby, overlooking how naturally ectoplasm is produced. Organically, the meaning of ectoplasm is simple. It is merely a collection of the energy gathered by a ghost in order for it to produce physical phenomena. It can be anything like sound, movement, sight, and such. Over time, ectoplasm gained validation, with most paranormal expert believing that honest physical mediums produce much of it.

If suddenly all the equipment in your house with batteries start shutting down, know that you have a paranormal presence in your house. It can be your clocks, your remotes, your cell phones, and anything else battery-operated. If it slows down, there could definitely be a ghost, spirit, or entity in your presence. Particularly since they use these little energy bundles in order to manifest. Realize though that spirits drain batteries just like ghosts do.
Touch

Ghosts do touch to make their presence felt. It could be just for fun, or they are trying to establish a line of communication with you. There is not always malice involved. Even I have had few experiences with paranormal entities touching me. The first time, I hysterically blurted out to never touch me again, and she didn’t. Yes, that was a female spirit. Therefore, understand that even with spirits, you can set certain physical boundaries. Thus, if you can’t get rid of them entirely, you often can reach an agreement and peacefully co-exist, provided you’re so inclined. And believe me, we’ve done that in a few places.
Cobwebs

It feels exactly like it would if you walked into a large cobweb in the attic. Generally, I feel these sensations both across the top of my head and across my face. Many people experience this cobweb sensation frequently. It isn’t actually good or bad. It’s just another sign there’s something actively happening in the area you’re in.

Not every nightmare is paranormal. Nor is something paranormal happening to everyone who has night terrors. However, when you sleep you’re incredibly open to spiritual, ghostly, and even the less pleasant influences. Therefore, I never rule out the possibility of these entities causing nightmares, which in turn can lead to night terrors. In fact, if we remembered half of what we encountered while on our nightly journeys, we’d probably be very impressed and yes sometimes even a bit horrified, although, we are protected for the most part.

These items might consist of purses, wallets, keys, change, pictures, and really almost anything relatively small.

Ghosts have not killed anyone till now but as paranormal investigators, we cannot rule out the possibility for the sake of sounding optimistic. There have been instances where it has been reported that the victim was pushed by a spirit leading him to lose his balance and taking a fall. There have been several other events that point to the fact that ghosts do have the capability to push you physically.

The strong energy I am talking about here is usually negative in nature.

This is one of the most common occurrences to happen in a haunted place. Cases in which bruise formation due to scratching on the skin have been reported. I have seen marks on people’s legs and back after they leave a place where there is paranormal activity. One of my team members never felt the sensation of being scratched or hurt but when we came out of a place where there was a report of spirit activity, we saw marks like lesions on his shin and even the inner part of his biceps. The interesting thing about these is that people don’t get the sensation of getting hurt or injured. All they are left with are the marks.

This leads them to have a say in our activities. It just wants to quench its thirst by making us a part of its body. This is very dangerous and is considered one of the worst things a spirit or a ghost can do to you.

It is something that has never happened and we hope that it never does. But being cheerful is not enough.
