posts.dek: Without fail, there are certain common haunting places around the globe where paranormal activity is always present. In this blog, we will quickly look at the haunted places with frequent ghost sightings and paranormal activity. Let’s get started!

body.text: Without fail, there are certain common haunting places around the globe where paranormal activity is always present. In this blog, we will quickly look at the haunted places with frequent ghost sightings and paranormal activity. Let’s get started!
Haunting Place – Burial Grounds

Burial grounds are hotspots for paranormal activity. We’ve heard about Indian Burial Grounds being something you don’t want to defile in any way. Unfortunately, many burial grounds were never recorded as such. Therefore, many homes and buildings have later been found to be built right on top of them. I’ve come across homes, apartments or entire housing societies known to be built on top of old gravesites. I guess partly because many years ago, in the times of terribly contagious diseases, instead of digging up the graves and possibly exposing the population to the disease, they often merely demarked the graves, erected new buildings, and life went on. Although this step was taken keeping the best intentions in mind, it didn’t make the souls in those graves very happy.

Therefore, we should always be mindful that any grounds because they are active haunting place. These were thought or designated to be sacred, be it burial or ceremonial, are much disturbed when we move atop them. Also, it is never entirely possible to change the purpose or the energy of the land without affecting it. Sometimes we can make peace with the energies that still reside there (I believe in many cases merely to oversee it) to co-exist. No guarantees, though, as the ghost may not want to peacefully co-exist or tolerate the seeming heresy, regardless of how innocent or unintentional it may have been, or you may be.
Also highly haunted are any places where dark rituals have happened

Think of a negative ritualistic haunting place. This too serves as paranormal activity hotspot. These never fail to continue to attract more negativity in the way of hostile ghosts and entities for many years to come, perhaps even for eternity. These are places where the energy has been corrupted, and it will take a lot of new and very positive energy to record over the dense, harsh, unpleasant, and heavy energy of the area. Therefore, these are places you don’t want to ever visit, let alone live.
Haunting Place – A Spot With a History of Horrible Events

Hauntings nearly always occur wherever some horrible thing has happened. Thus these places are hotspots for paranormal activity. Places hold the energy of events. They even grab the energy of the emotions of the people who experienced the event, both the victims and the perpetrators. Therefore, if something charged with negative emotions has happened in or around your home, it’s likely haunted. Often, even if it’s only in the vicinity of your house, the ground can still absorb enough of the event to create a ripple effect into the surrounding areas. Spots that come to mind as rather prominent examples are prisons, concentration camps, places of a mass tragedy such as the Twin Towers, Underground Railroad houses, any house where a crime has occurred, and all battlegrounds.

Think of the Civil War battlegrounds as they too are active haunting place. Any location where a person experiences intense emotion usually has some haunting residue left meandering about. And, if there were large numbers of people involved, the energy is only further condensed. Then, the larger the number of people involved, the more extreme the emotion was, the more noticeably and actively haunted the location.
Haunting Place – Abandoned Hospitals and Funeral Parlors

Also, anywhere near either of these places is hotspots for paranormal activity. Wherever deaths are common, even when of the gentler variety, at least occasional hauntings will occur. Souls sometimes don’t know they’ve passed and are reluctant to cross over. Thus, they remain, and they roam around looking for someone to help them understand what they need to do next. Too, sometimes they wander for reasons not so pleasant. So building in or around hospitals and funeral homes can be tricky.
Haunting Place – An ancient building or house

It only makes sense that these properties have stored the energy of everything that’s gone on before. It might be great energy, and it might not be. The only thing that’s for sure is if it’s an old structure, it’s been through some stuff. Meaning every victory and celebration, love and heartbreak, as well as every fall and hardship, has been recorded to one extent or another.

Again, the more challenging or more extraordinary the event, the denser the emotion stored at a place of haunting. On that same note, know too that all the inhabitants’ energy is also stored in varying degrees. An example of this might be one in which you purchase a property that a psychic lived in. Suppose it was a road-weary psychic who knew how to protect the property. In that case, you’ll likely still experience perhaps a few ghost survivors who are still hanging around looking for their friend, but they’ll only be of the pleasant variety and likely won’t stay for long.

Plus, you may even have purchased a quiet, serene, and well spiritually tended house due to the psychic’s efforts. But it still can be a haunting place. This would be an excellent find. On the other hand, if you purchased the property of a psychic who practiced ritual magic, realize that they’ve drawn things into the home that was a part of their belief system. As such, the energy might feel “off” to those who are not a part of it. But, if a psychic who practiced black magic owned your property, you’ve purchased a problem. The house will be full of dark energy and dark spirits. These energies don’t even care that the psychic is gone because you’re enough.
Random Places Known to be Haunted

Like they say, where there’s smoke, there’s usually fire. Thus, if you hear of a haunting place that others claim to have had experiences in, chances are, you will too. So unless you’re prepared to deal with the fall-out, you might pass. There most certainly are many other sites and circumstances that openly incite haunting experiences, but these are the top six. So before buying any property, always look into these things before signing the dotted line. And, if you’re purchasing one of the above types of properties, know that the energies your place has encountered will indeed influence it. Therefore, random places are hotspots for paranormal activity.

The only real question is, “How Much?” Unfortunately, you won’t know that about haunted places or place of haunting until you’ve unpacked your bags. Sometimes you won’t know for several months after having moved in. Hopefully, the energy has either faded or gone dormant, and you’ll be free to record new memories and implant new energies in your home. But I’d hesitate if there are any signs that a haunting might exist.
Often Land is Also Among the Haunted Places

Remember to also check out the land. Just because you’re building a new home doesn’t mean much. The land and all the organic substances in the land will hold onto energy as much or more so than any piece of wood or marble might. So before you ever think of piling in the bunk beds, figure out precisely what history you are inheriting. Maybe you can begin by asking the current owner what they know about the house and property. Then ask the neighbors. You can also pull up copies of the local newspaper archives, visit a historian, or get a copy of the original property abstract.

Seriously, you can’t do too much. It’s just so much easier to know what you’re facing going in than finding out after you’ve already committed to something. Much like you want the history of any used car, you also need to get your house or property history. Remember, every thought, action, and deed is energy. You are in energy. Your thoughts and feelings are energy. Every event you ever encounter brings in more energy. And, the dead are now nothing but energy. Energy begets energy.

posts.title: Science of the Paranormal: The Science Behind Ghosts
posts.excerpt: Thermodynamics and relativity get invoked constantly to explain ghosts. What they actually support, and what they do not.
posts.dek: There is no empirical evidence suggesting that ghosts and spirits do exist. In this blog, we will discuss the science of the paranormal and try to discuss some theories and bust a few myths.

body.text: There is no empirical evidence suggesting that ghosts and spirits do exist. The most important thing is how you see and perceive the world. A person’s belief is a crucial aspect in deciding whether he believes in supernatural entities or not. We, humans, have two aspects to us. One is the physical aspect, and the other is the mental or the everlasting aspect. The physical aspect comprises our form and shape. At the same time, the everlasting aspect consists of our personality. This is what we call one’s soul or spirit. In this blog, we will discuss the science of the paranormal and try to discuss some theories and bust a few myths.
Science of the Paranormal: Theories and Ghosts

According to the thermodynamics theory, energy can neither be created nor be destroyed but can be transferred from one configuration to another. This theory talks about the energy or the everlasting aspect I talked about in the last paragraph. So, where do we end up? Does this mean that the total amount of energy in our universe is continual? If we take this theory as the thumb rule, then yes.
Science of the Paranormal: Energies and Ghosts

Einstein’s theory of relativity also talks about the connection between matter and energy. In this, Einstein talks about how energy and matter are replaceable. He also talks about the amount of energy in the universe being fixed. For those who are forgetting what the equation was, let me just refresh your memory: E = mc².

To understand the science of the paranormal, this translates into the assumption that we transfer our energy from one form of life into another when we pass away. We do it in the same way wind energy is converted into electrical energy with the help of windmills, and hydropower is converted into electrical energy with the help of dams. In both of these cases, we can see here that they fulfil the first law of thermodynamics that says that energy can neither be created nor be eliminated and maintains equilibrium throughout the universe.
We Still Need More Substantial Evidence

Hence, the deduced result looks strong, but the out-and-out proof is still nowhere near. Some previous instances suggest that there is a possibility of a supernatural force beyond us and our realm. But we have not been able to produce concrete proof as to the existence of such entities. Many people talk about their experiences with the supernatural, and you, too, my dear reader, might have experienced something occult, but that’s your story against modern-day science.

So the issue in contention is whether the theories and the science of the paranormal prove the existence of such supernatural beings. The answer, in my opinion, is a big no. There are times when we get facts from seemingly good and trusted channels, but it becomes tough to point your finger and say that it is from a ghost or a spirit.
Are Ghosts Thoughts?

A very intriguing thesis about the science of the paranormal comes from India. In our texts, there are several mentions regarding supernatural entities’ existence, and they basically say that ghosts are nothing but the imagination of our very own thoughts. These thoughts are related to our own emotions. These emotions can be anything ranging from love to fear. This is why we think that we see a ghost or a spirit, and it is all in our heads. The conjecture also says that a firm belief in the supernatural makes people see things that don’t exist in the real world. This theory then further goes into saying that the people who see the supernatural are the ones who have greater brain conscience.
To Wrap it Up

All told, we as paranormal researchers are here to explore the unexplored. For us to understand the science of the paranormal, we have to first believe in them. One cannot be a non-believer and then be a paranormal researcher at the same time. This requires your mind to be open to new thoughts and ideas. It should not be a closed box but an open one. One should be expecting any possibility that might happen.

My tryst with the supernatural has shown me that specific ideas do work when we are tackling a paranormal activity or a ghost. We don’t know if this paranormal activity is the result of a spirit or a living human, but we know for sure that there is an activity, and this is a great place to start. In a stern way, I can say that ghosts have passed on, and they are the aura of a dead human who once walked on the face of the earth.

posts.title: Cause of Hauntings — Why Do Hauntings Happen?
posts.excerpt: Most hauntings begin with an invitation nobody remembers sending — a board, an argument, a hunt, or simply wanting one badly enough.
posts.dek: Why is that a particular home or place is haunted? What could be the reason behind the hauntings? In this excerpt, we will look at the cause of hauntings and why paranormal activity happens.

body.text: Now that you have determined that something from the other side is present in a house, maybe yours — do you want to know why? Why is that a particular home or place is haunted? What could be the reason behind the hauntings? In this excerpt, we will look at the cause of hauntings and why paranormal activity happens.
Major Cause of Hauntings

Well, there are many reasons a house can become haunted. Sometimes, it’s only because of the location. Perhaps you live next to a funeral parlour or cemetery. If so, you definitely could be getting a lot of transient ghosts. Meaning, as the soul leaves the body, they sometimes wander around trying to get their bearings.

Mainly if their passing was sudden or unexpected, sometimes too, a soul chooses to stay around for a while. This is also a cause of hauntings. Thus, if your house is near their departure site or a cemetery, they will make their way to you at some point in time. If this is the case, usually they’ll just pass through. But, there are numerous other reasons that a soul may set up residence in your house. Want to know why? Let’s have a look!
Did You Invite Them?

Let’s start with the obvious first cause of hauntings, that being, you invited them. I know you’re saying, “No. I never did that!” But think hard. Have you or haven’t you? I have experienced things happening in the homes that I have lived in for many reasons. Since I was a child, I always had this acute sixth sense present in me. And it was comparatively easy for me to see and listen to these spirits. The volatile environment in my house complimented it. Ever since then, they haven’t left me. And wherever I go, I know I am not alone! Having said that, let’s address each of them separately.
Do You Use Ouija Boards?

In all the fancy ghost movies, you always see an ouija board and some kids messing with it. Oftentimes, it has led to disastrous consequences. Do you know why? Let’s understand what are ouija boards first. Ouija boards are merely a piece of wood or laminate with a little planchette attached. So they, in and of themselves, are harmless, right? I mean, they even sell them in the toy department, so they can’t be too dangerous, right? In truth, what makes an ouija board dangerous is the “reason” people buy them. Let’s face it, there’s only one reason you’re using an ouija board, and that reason is to connect with someone no longer in this world — a ghost, a spirit, or some sort of guide.

The problem is that most people don’t protect their ouija board any more than they defend themselves before sending out this otherworldly invitation. This becomes a cause of hauntings and paranormal activity. Personally, if I were to use an ouija, I’d likely pray over the board heavily, suggesting that only things of the white light be allowed to commune through it. Instead, though, most rip open the box, light a few candles, and hope more than anything that the darn planchette moves and gives them some positive, uplifting message.

Thus, no matter what your intent is when you open up casually to contact those who are departed, it’s a mistake. Especially when you are using zero protection for yourself or the board, it’s like leaving your front door open with all your best goodies fully on display, just hoping the “right” people are attracted in.
Does Your Home Resonate a Lot of Negative Energy?

Ghosts are attracted to negative energy. It’s mainly because it’s far denser than positive energy. For them to manifest and be seen or heard, they need energy; the more, the better. Unfortunately, negative energy gives them the meat they need to make material things happen, precisely because it’s denser.

Therefore, if there’s chaos, arguments, turmoil, and a more-than-the-average amount of drama in your house, realize that the ghosts and entities see this as an energy-feeding hub. They’re also drawn in not only because of the amount and type of the energy but because the mainly negative entities and grumpy ghosts prefer negative and hostile energy environments.

It seems not only does it supply the gas to their fire, but it is also their desired meal. Think about it, negatives like negative things. They like to create chaos, havoc, problems, and stress. So if they can find a “home” already full of such things, they can swoop right in, feast, and in doing so, make everything a whole bunch worse.

However, just know that if things start hitting a downward spiral and you can’t seem to get a handle on it, you just might have a very unpleasant ghost or entity taking up residence and compiling their negativity on top of yours. Therefore, if you can remember that whenever there’s negativity in your home, if there’s a way to keep your sense of humour, sense of proportion, faith, and determination to stay positive, you must do it. To get rid of ghosts, cleanse your home environment first. That makes a huge difference.
Do You Hunt Ghosts, or Are You a Paranormal Researcher?

If you are a paranormal researcher or you go ghost hunting, know that some of them have never left your side. Intentionally or unintentionally, you welcomed some of those to your house. Ghost hunting in and of itself isn’t a bad thing to do. It’s interesting. It gives us proof of life after death. Sometimes we can even help the ghost on its way once we’ve found it; a real win-win. However, too many people pick up a flashlight, maybe a recorder, and take off to the scariest place in town, just praying they’ll find a ghost. If you don’t protect yourself before you begin your hunt and immediately after it, you may have a severe ghost attachment problem. They will often just hitchhike home with you.

They know you’re looking for them, and more than anything, they sometimes just want to be found. So you have the same as welcomed them into your life, albeit quite unintentionally. Even if you use all the precaution and protection methods out there, sometimes when you ghost hunt, they still follow you home. There’s simply no avoiding it. It happens to even those of us who are super experienced on occasion.

Therefore, it becomes of the utmost importance to follow the right instruction while hunting ghosts. If you are a novice, I recommend that you stop and learn first. Without the proper knowledge, you won’t be able to decipher the right from the wrong, the ghosts from the whiff!
Do You Want to See a Ghost?

Most people want to see a ghost. Again, to get proof of life after death, or perhaps even get the adrenaline rush of a good scare, or entirely just out of curiosity. I get it. I also completely understand why people go looking for them. The thing is if you want something badly enough, generally you’ll get it. So again, it’s an invitation given and sent out in the form of energy.

And, what are ghosts? Energy. There is no matter left. Therefore, they eat, breathe, manipulate, and read, hear, smell, and touch energy. Your thoughts are energy. Your words are also energy. Consequently, if you want to see a ghost, chances are super good that you will. Let me insert right now that all spirits are not evil.

So, it’s not always a bad thing to see a ghost. I’ve had hundreds of experiences where seeing a ghost was not even really all that scary. Sometimes, it was just a thing. Sometimes I was even able to help the ghost move on to another place. Then, it’s a great thing. The only real time it’s terrible is when you’ve got a hold of a bad ghost or, worse, a dark entity, which isn’t as common as most believe. But it happens.
Being a Psychic or Having a Psychic Child

First, know that when someone is born sensitive or psychic, they just are born that way. They can’t change that any more than you can change the colour of your eyes. Being psychic is a powerful gift, just as being an artist is. There is no shame in it. So if you are psychic, or your child or other family member is, it just is. My advice is to deal with that the best you can, but never take any of it to heart. Never. The second most challenging thing about being a psychic is that you can’t often find the help and guidance you need to rein in your gifts and protect yourself fully. This sort of leaves you like “that open door” to all in the world of energy, spirit, and ghosts.
Did Something Harsh Happen in Your House in the Past?

Knowing that every house has a past, just like people do — if not the house, the land — you must realize the energy already stored in your house. Simply understand that all events that have ever happened in a home or on its ground have left an energy imprint. Naturally, the bigger the event and the stronger the emotion involved, the larger the imprint.

For example, have you ever walked into a room and felt the lingering effects of an argument someone else had in the room even though you weren’t a part of it? You can feel in that instant how the energy of the room has been affected, perhaps even contaminated, by the negative feelings. You just automatically feel uncomfortable and may even grow a little tense or on-edge yourself in reaction to it. Conversely, think of visiting a temple. Even when you’re alone in a temple, you wouldn’t feel right shouting out and acting all crazy, simply because the place’s energy is solemn, sacred. The reason is that it’s always been solemn and sacred.
In Conclusion to the Cause of Hauntings

At the very least, now you know it’s not in your head. Now you know how even unintentionally, you might have invited them. It often goes unnoticed how our actions have equal and opposite reactions. But that is the thing about energies. They manifest. And they will manifest whenever they get the opportunity.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence a good paranormal investigator should advise his clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Most of your clients may feel desperate due to whatever they are going through. It’s your duty to act responsibly. Guide them through the path of modern science. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.

posts.title: What’s After Death?
posts.excerpt: What people describe when they are brought back — the light, the guide, and the ones who run the other way.
posts.dek: According to my belief systems, life goes beyond our death. By death, I mean clinical death. Your personality, energy, emotions, and memories just go on without any pause.

body.text: Have you ever thought about what happens after death, after we die? I am sure you have. We all have. According to my belief systems, life goes beyond our death. By death, I mean clinical death. There are instances where hypnotized people feel as if they are alive following clinical death. Your personality, energy, emotions, and memories just go on without any pause. In addition, the fact that the soul can never die is ratified by the former life. Let us now understand this from the perspective of a paranormal expert in Chennai, India.
What’s After Death?

A lot of research has gone into exploring clinical death and near-death scenarios. Many paranormal experts in Chennai feel the same. The findings suggest that people have the same experiences as hypnotized ones. Their findings were found from the interviews of the various people who died and then were later brought around. Most of my patients recall death experiences under hypnosis.

From where I stand, death seems like a calm and even transition to the spirit universe without any loss of memories and consciousness. The accounts of my clients suggest that they felt a consolation from pain and a feeling of letting go of their fears just before they leave their bodies. They felt light and the lift-off from their bodies made them see everything that was happening below them. Also, they try to console their loved ones by telling them that they are doing well and are fine.
What Happens When We Die?

They just go on, drawn towards a bright light. The light is white and has a warm aura around it. It gives them a feeling of comfort and warmth. Loved ones also come, who have already died and guided them towards passing to another side. They also saw themselves in perfect shape and form as all of their imperfections have now been done with. Blind people could perfectly see and the deaf would again have their hearing back. People with deformed bodies due to freak accidents and natural ailments are able to see themselves as normal. Furthermore, their spirit self also seems and feels real just like their physical body.

Accounts of these people also suggest that they felt like they were watching a film as everything is vivid and clear. Maybe this is what happens when we die. Also, the people who have had near-death experiences say that they see their life flash before their eyes. The use of this was to tell them what challenges they passed and where they had shortcomings. Spirit counsellors also tell them about the changes they have to make in order to make progress when it comes to spirituality.
Experiences After Death

I have files that have records of people that tell us about death and what one experiences after death. It also explains what happens when we die. Paranormal experts in Chennai, India study them to answer many puzzling questions. For example, let me tell you the story of Narendra, a 28-year-old man from Jhansi. Narendra suffered from depression and also had a problem related to his throat. Whenever he consumed cold water, his throat became very irritated and developed a cough.

Following the instruction in order to regress the events responsible for his problem, he saw himself as a young man living in Patna. The time was during the 1950s. His accounts tell that he had a very tough childhood and he got into many fights. He won those fights as he came from a family of wrestlers and had a huge frame. Further sessions also told a lot about him.

He saw himself lying in the sun. There was a sense of hunger in his gut as he felt as if he had not eaten food for days. He saw a river just flowing through the trees. There were other men who were sitting under the trees and were eating something. He also saw himself dressed in a khaki uniform. The feeling of being tired engulfed him and he said that he feels good fighting for the people who are not able to fight for themselves. He saw himself running to cross a creek. His feet kept on getting hit with small stones on the ground.
Linear

People were chasing him and his team, firing at them and making them run away. He got caught as a soldier hit him and put his head inside the water forcing him to choke. The other soldier was abusing him and telling him that he is being taught a lesson. He felt like swallowing all the water. According to him, then he felt a floating sensation. The feeling of being light as a feather.

He also felt as if someone was watching him as he saw bodies of other men laying around him. They were also leaving their bodies and rising. Then he saw a person who told him that his fight was over and then it was followed by a wonderful sense of satisfaction. There was no pain. It was all very calm and still. The feeling of absolute tranquillity lay at him like a blanket on a cold winter night. It was very fulfilling as his part was over.

Most of the experiences related to death that happens when we die and as narrated by hypnotized patients had a linear and predictable storyline. But then there were others that were quite a contrast. They did not have a linear transition from one realm to another. There are accounts of people that talk about running from the light instead of following it.
After Death Experience — Sense to Fight Back to Life

People feel a sense of terror as they don’t know what is happening to them. They see the light and are often scared of the aura of it. It becomes uneasy and a sense of fighting back to stay kicks in. Most people don’t like change. They are happy where they are. Acceptance is also a key issue here. People are not able to accept the fact that their life on earth as walking and talking humans is over. Another thing that needs to be addressed here is that some people are also not able to understand that they are dead.

They are unaware of their passing. The reasons can be multiple. Death could have happened due to being involved in an accident which gives them no time to process their end. Sudden death results in this kind of behaviour. In some cases, spirits seem to possess or control living people. This was evident from the account of a patient who was under treatment for depression. It was because of it that she was so suicidal. There are several other instances that throw a light on what happens after death.
To Wrap It Up

Another very interesting description was given by a girl who died by suicide in her past life. She told that due to the depression she killed herself. After her demise, she roamed the planet for a number of years. At last, she found the light and went towards it which led her to pass on to the other side.

The one thing that is common in all of my patients is the fact that they all see a light at the end of the tunnel. There is very little known about the light itself. Some people call it God’s energy while others refer to it as the love that is unconditional. All we know is that it is a very bright light, just like the sun. People feel the warmth and a sense of protection from the light.

However, the most frequent description involves the presence of light and also a guide. People have shared experiences that talk of a guide whom they meet after death. He brings a sense of tranquillity to the shock of death. According to numerous accounts, the guide helps them to pass on to the other side of the other world. People feel good. They feel protected. There is also a sense of joy.

Most of the accounts in my experience point out the fact that death is not as dark or negative as many of us make it out to be. Death is beautiful according to most of the patients. When an individual makes his leap towards the light, he is not full of malice or terror. He is full of warmth and a feeling of completion. The circle is complete. The race is over. Now it’s time to move on to another space. The space is unknown but it feels good. Death is the ultimate reality. What happens after death, we all will know.

posts.title: What are Orbs: Meaning of Orbs
posts.excerpt: Nearly every orb is dust on the lens. The five conditions that make one worth a second look.
posts.dek: An orb is also known as a ball of light as it has a glow in it and is in a spherical shape. People believe that orbs contain the energy of the people who have died and are basically the remnants of what the person used to be.

body.text: You may have come across the term “orbs” millions of times when talking or watching anything paranormal. So, do you know what are orbs? There have been instances when visual anomalies have been caught by a camera. These anomalies look odd and unusual when we look at the pictures of them. An orb is also one such anomaly. It looks like a ball in most cases and has a very strange feel to it. In this excerpt, we will discuss the meaning of orbs and other interesting details related to it in a paranormal investigation.
What are Orbs?

An orb is also known as a ball of light as it has a glow in it and is in a spherical shape. People believe that orbs contain the energy of the people who have died and are basically the remnants of what the person used to be. While the cynics are of the belief that they are nothing but particles of dust and dirt. Both the cynics and the believers have different and polarised opinions when it comes to orbs. Then there are the ones whose beliefs are in between the two.
Meaning of Orbs

Now let us understand the meaning of orbs. Orbs are not always important in paranormal terms. It can be just dirt, dust, or smoke in the surrounding. But when it is observable by naked eyes then it becomes a thing of intrigue.

An orb is usually regarded as a CPC — close proximity contamination — and usually is found in close proximity to the camera. CPC is nothing but elements that are found in our surroundings. These elements tend to adulterate the lens and are visible in the field of view of the lens. It includes raindrops, water, moisture, dust, dirt, wool, skin, fibres, insects, spiderwebs, hair, and so on.

So, we can see that the above things can surely adulterate the picture making people believe that the anomaly they see in the picture is an energy or a form of energy. But, the elements I quoted above are very common. Our environment is filled with particles that are enough to contaminate a photo or a video. Hence, the question arises — are all orbs dust particles?

According to me, not all things happening in life are coincidences. The orbs can be anything but in most cases they are particles. There is no scientific evidence that suggests that these orbs are in fact of the paranormal world. So, it completely depends upon the situation and what you believe in.
Now that you know the meaning of orbs, let me tell you about the instances when an orb is paranormally important.
When Orbs are the Source of Light

An orb becomes paranormally important when the light emitted from the orb comes from the orb. This means that in cases where the orb itself is the source of the light then it becomes paranormally interesting. You need to keep in mind that if the light is coming from the background or is due to reflection from a source of light then it is not as important.
When Orbs Can Be Seen By Your Own Eyes

Sometimes, our camera is not able to do justice to the picture and due to the contamination in the environment, the photograph also gets contaminated. You need to understand that our eyes are the best camera when it comes to spotting an entity. One should trust their own eyes and be careful while analyzing a photograph as it can be anything. So, whenever an orb is visible from your bare eyes then it becomes a point of interest for you.
When the Orb’s Path Makes Sense

When you spot an orb from your eyes, it should not just be stagnant or floating erratically in the background. For it to make sense it should have a smart and intelligent path. It should not just be there floating around but should make some sense. As a paranormal investigator one should always try to make sense in such situations. Most importantly, try and capture such an event from a camera so that further paranormal investigation can be conducted on it.
Orbs Should Not Be Hazy

One should lookout for an orb that is not blurry or hazy but is sharp. By this, I mean that the structure of the orb should be clearly visible and the light coming out of it should also be apparent. Sometimes, materials such as pollen, dust, and dirt also look like an orb of paranormal nature but what separates them from an orb of actual paranormal nature is their cloudy texture. Hence, the orb should have a clear-cut structure and must be clearly visible from your eyes.
When There is an EMF Reading

The job of an EMF meter is to capture the change in the electromagnetic waves of the environment. The full form of EMF is electromagnetic field. There is an electromagnetic field present in the environment at all times. This field gets a spike when we are near an object that works in a different frequency than us. Whenever you place your EMF meter near your laptop or television, you will see a spike in the EMF readings. This spike is due to the change in electromagnetic fields.

So when you spot an orb and spontaneously there is also a spike on your EMF meter then you will have what we call corroborating evidence. This means that you have not one but two confirmations suggesting the presence of a paranormal entity.
Conclusion

The most important factor in the field of paranormal investigation is your own gut feeling. If you feel that what you see is backed up by your instincts then you should pursue such events on your own level. For example, if you see an orb and it gives you a strong sense of negativity coupled with your own gut feeling then it is also an indication that the orb is from the paranormal world. Remember that you should first cancel out any instance of contamination before proceeding with the paranormal investigation in a serious manner. This will save you time as well as your energy.

posts.title: Most Haunted Places With Paranormal Activity is Prominent
posts.excerpt: Burial grounds, battlefields, old hospitals, older houses — the six kinds of place that hold what happened there, and how to check before you buy.
posts.dek: Without fail, there are certain places that account for the most haunted place always. Places like these around the globe where paranormal activity is always present.

body.text: Without fail, there are certain places that account for the most haunted place always. Places like these around the globe where paranormal activity is always present. In this blog, we will quickly look at the most haunted places with frequent ghost sightings and activities. Let’s get started!
Most Haunted Places — Burial Grounds or Sacred Grounds

We’ve likely all heard by now about Indian burial grounds being something you don’t want to defile in any way. This is a hotspot for any paranormal activity. Unfortunately, many burial grounds were never recorded as such. Therefore, many homes and buildings have later been found to be built right on top of them. I’ve heard of entire housing societies and even a city or two known to be built on top of old gravesites. I guess partly because many years ago, in the times of terribly contagious diseases, instead of digging up the graves and possibly exposing the population to the disease, they often merely demarked the graves, erected new buildings, and life went on. Although this step was taken keeping the best intentions in mind, it didn’t make the souls in those graves very happy.

Therefore, we should always be mindful of any grounds that were thought or designated to be sacred, be it burial or ceremonial. They are among the most haunted places, and they are much disturbed when we move atop them. Also, it is never entirely possible to change the purpose or the energy of the land without affecting it. Sometimes we can make peace with the energies that still reside there — I believe in many cases merely to oversee it — to co-exist. No guarantees, though, as the ghost may not want to peacefully co-exist or tolerate the seeming heresy, regardless of how innocent or unintentional it may have been, or you may be.
Also Most Haunted are Any Places Where Dark Things Have Happened

Think of a negative ritualistic haunting place. This is a hotspot for any paranormal activity. These never fail to continue to attract more negativity in the way of hostile ghosts and entities for many years to come, perhaps even for eternity. These are places where the energy has been corrupted, and it will take a lot of new and very positive energy to record over the dense, harsh, unpleasant, and heavy energy of the area. Therefore, these are places you don’t want to ever visit, let alone live.
Most Haunted Places — A Spot With a History of Horrible Events

Hauntings nearly always occur wherever some horrible thing has happened. Therefore, this, too, is a hotspot for any paranormal activity. Places hold the energy of events. They even grab the energy of the emotions of the people who experienced the event, both the victims and the perpetrators. Therefore, if something charged with negative emotions has happened in or around your home, it’s likely haunted. Often, even if it’s only in the vicinity of your house, the ground can still absorb enough of the event to create a ripple effect into the surrounding areas. Spots that come to mind as rather prominent examples are prisons, concentration camps, places of a mass tragedy such as the Twin Towers, Underground Railroad houses, any house where a crime has occurred, and all battlegrounds.

Think of the Civil War battlegrounds as they too are among the most haunted places. Any location where a person experiences intense emotion usually has some haunting residue left meandering about. And, if there were large numbers of people involved, the energy is only further condensed. Then, the larger the number of people involved, the more extreme the emotion was, the more noticeably and actively haunted the location.
Abandoned Hospitals and Funeral Parlours

Also, anywhere near either of these places serves as a hotspot for paranormal activity. Wherever deaths are common, even when of the gentler variety, at least occasional hauntings will occur. Souls sometimes don’t know they’ve passed and are reluctant to cross over. Thus, they remain, and they roam around looking for someone to help them understand what they need to do next. Too, sometimes they wander for reasons not so pleasant. So building in or around hospitals and funeral homes can be tricky.
An Ancient Building or House

An ancient building or house also accounts for the most haunted places in the world. It only makes sense that these properties have stored the energy of everything that’s gone on before. It might be great energy, and it might not be. The only thing that’s for sure is if it’s an old structure, it’s been through some stuff. Meaning every victory and celebration, love and heartbreak, as well as every fall and hardship, has been recorded to one extent or another.

Again, the more challenging or more extraordinary the event, the denser the emotion stored at a place of haunting. On that same note, know too that all the inhabitants’ energy is also stored in varying degrees. An example of this might be one in which you purchase a property that a psychic lived in. Suppose it was a road-weary psychic who knew how to protect the property. In that case, you’ll likely still experience perhaps a few ghost survivors who are still hanging around looking for their friend, but they’ll only be of the pleasant variety and likely won’t stay for long.

Plus, you may even have purchased a quiet, serene, and well spiritually tended house due to the psychic’s efforts. But it still can be a haunting place. This would be an excellent find. On the other hand, if you purchased the property of a psychic who practised ritual magic, realize that they’ve drawn things into the home that were a part of their belief system. As such, the energy might feel “off” to those who are not a part of it.
Random Places Known to be Haunted

Like they say, where there’s smoke, there’s usually fire. Thus, if you hear of a haunted place that others claim to have had experiences in, chances are, you will too. This is also a hotspot for any paranormal activity. So unless you’re prepared to deal with the fall-out, you might pass. There most certainly are many other sites and circumstances that openly incite haunting experiences, but these are the top six. So before buying any property, always look into these things before signing the dotted line. And, if you’re purchasing one of the above types of properties, know that the energies your place has encountered will indeed influence it.

The only real question is, “How much?” Unfortunately, you won’t know that about haunted places until you’ve unpacked your bags. Sometimes you won’t know for several months after having moved in. Hopefully, the energy has either faded or gone dormant, and you’ll be free to record new memories and implant new energies in your home. But I’d hesitate if there are any signs that a haunting might exist.
Often Land is Also Among the Haunted Places

Remember to also check out the land, because it too counts among the most haunted places. This is a hotspot for any paranormal activity. Just because you’re building a new home doesn’t mean much. The land and all the organic substances in the land will hold onto energy as much or more so as any piece of wood or marble might. So before you ever think of piling in the bunk beds, figure out precisely what history you are inheriting. Maybe you can begin by asking the current owner what they know about the house and property. Then ask the neighbours. You can also pull up copies of the local newspaper archives, visit a historian, or get a copy of the original property abstract.

Seriously, you can’t do too much. It’s just so much easier to know what you’re facing going in than finding out after you’ve already committed to something. Much like you want the history of any used car, you also need to get your house or property history. Remember, every thought, action, and deed is energy. You are energy. Your thoughts and feelings are energy. Every event you ever encounter brings in more energy. And, the dead are now nothing but energy. Energy begets energy.

posts.title: Types of Spirit Guides: What are They?
posts.excerpt: Guardians, archangels, animals, the family who went before — the several kinds of help that arrive without being asked for.
posts.dek: We have a whole team of divine helpers looking out for us. Spirits are souls that have passed on to the afterlife in a relatively typical fashion, and they become our guiding angels — like the voice you hear from inside saying that “it’s not the right thing to do.”

body.text: We have a whole team of divine helpers looking out for us, including spirit and spirit guides. So, what are spirit guides? Spirits are souls that have passed on to the afterlife in a relatively typical fashion. They are not tied down to a single place or thing. Since they vibrate at a much higher frequency than other paranormal beings, they need substantially greater energy to manifest in the material world. Such spirits become our guiding angels, like the voice you hear from inside saying that “it’s not the right thing to do.” To an extent, spirits have free will and can move easily across dimensions. If a spirit visits you, it’s often a result of an emotional tie. Having said that, in this excerpt, we will discuss the types of spirit guides residing in the paranormal universe.
Different Types of Spirit Guides

Spirit guides come in many forms, and they each have a different name. They have always been around and seen you go through the good and bad events of your life. Their presence has also altered many of your decisions in your everyday life, which you might not have noticed or known about. Now, I will take you through the various types of spirit guides out there in a brief but chaste manner for you to learn more about them.
Types of Spirit Guides — Guardian Angels

Guardian angels only work for your benefit. Their whole existence is just to make your life easier and help you out through thick and thin. They are attached to you in a manner that they become a part of you. Now, you can have one or many of them around you. It all depends upon your luck and need. Another vital thing to note here is that the guardian angels are beyond our caste, creed, or gender and love you unconditionally.
Types of Spirit Guides — Archangels

Archangels possess a lot of power and are at a high spot in the religious hierarchy. They emanate immense energy, and you can feel their presence when near you or around you. In addition, an archangel can be an usher or a guide to take you through the challenging situations in your life. For example, the archangel Michael is the angel who protects. Many regard him as the most powerful of all the other six archangels.
Types of Spirit Guides — Spirit Animals

A spirit animal is basically an animal present around you in the form of energy and is acting as a guiding force in your life. So, it can be a pet that you had and shared a bond with, which has now transcended from life to the afterlife.
Types of Spirit Guides — Deceased Family Members

There might be someone in your family who has died and is not there anymore physically, but he or she might be there around you, in the form of energy emanating from the heavens. They have now become your friends in the paranormal and try to help you tackle challenging situations in your life by being a guide to you.
Ascended Masters

An ascended master once lived on earth as a human being but is not with us anymore. They are someone who has done things for the betterment and the upliftment of the entire human race in their ways. Now they act as energies to help us go through this life and provide us with the right conscience that invokes us to do good.
Helper Angels
Any angel who is just trying to help you without even knowing you just out of goodwill is a helper angel. Their main aim is to find a human in distress and help him get through testing times.

posts.title: What are Demons: Demons and Negative Entities Explained
posts.excerpt: The foul odour, the chill, the scratches — what a demonic presence actually feels like, and the one sensible response to it.
posts.dek: Demons are considered as negative entities who show evil traits. According to my view demons are fallen angels who have sinned and lost the trust of God. A demon wants to be revered and prayed to by people.

body.text: We all have heard the term “demon”, at some point in our lives. So what are demons? Most of us know what it signifies — negativity. But to understand the meaning of demons and why it is so scary in any paranormal investigation, we need to understand it from a different viewpoint.

Demons are considered as negative entities who show evil traits. They are also known to bow down to Satan who controls them and their actions. According to my view demons are fallen angels who have sinned and lost the trust of God. They pray to Satan and derive all their power from him and the people who fear them. A demon wants to be revered and prayed to by people. It wants all your attention and aims to rule and thrive on our weaknesses.

Let us now move forward with the intention to try and understand the meaning of demons in a broad way (Western learnings). I will also take into account my encounters with demons that will help you know more about them.
An Introduction — Meaning of Demons

Whenever I’ve had an encounter with a demon, the one thing that it always brought was the foul odour. Therefore, the meaning of demons is synonymous with a foul odour in any paranormal investigation. It smells as if someone has thrown rotten eggs in your room. The smell itself is so strong and disgusting that it sometimes also causes a feeling of nausea. You also feel a deep chill and fear rise from your toes and travel across your spine to your ears.

The feeling of anxiety also comes into play which causes a whirling sensation in your stomach. It is not a very pleasant feeling. You want to get away from it and you should. The kind of negativity the whole atmosphere emanates from such an evil presence might even cause scratches on your body.

So, whenever I spot scratches, foul odour, and the feeling of negativity that sends a chilling sensation across my body, I just leave the place immediately. Getting out of the affected place or a room is followed by detoxing myself and then just finding a place where I can pray. Praying during such a scenario in a paranormal investigation is of importance as it helps to ensure that I am not carrying them with me.
Demons and Angels Co-exist

Just know that demons and angels co-exist in our world. Many paranormal investigations are proof of this. They both have been around for the longest time. So, you just cannot get rid of one if they decide to follow you or cling on to you. It all depends on what they want and what is their intention. Usually, the intention of a demon is to cause physical and emotional damage to you and the people around you.

Hence, you have to be very careful and leave such things to people who have experience in the field and have special capabilities to negotiate with the situation. I myself have seen and felt a number of demons over the course of my life but managed to come out fine from the situation. Again I would like to reiterate that I would not choose to get into such a scenario again. There are people who are willing and are okay with doing so. Therefore, you should leave it with them when it comes to demons.
Why Should You Not Encourage Negative Entities?

Another reason why I don’t encourage anyone to get into a skirmish with a demon is because once you decide to fight with them, it becomes a war of a lifetime. You can not choose to leave the fight in the middle. The demon loves to fight you and it finds satisfaction in hurting you and the people around you.

A demon neither forgets nor forgives. It can even remember your name and will follow you everywhere you go to make your life difficult. Even then if you decide to take up that fight and end up evoking or annoying a demon then you will find yourself in such disarray that you won’t be able to get out of it.

This is the reason that I rarely prick or annoy any supernatural entity in any paranormal investigation. You don’t know at the start if the energy you are feeling is positive or negative. You also do not have an idea regarding if it is indeed a demon or not. So, I never start with being annoying or too stingy at the start. My protocol is to first check for initial signs and then decide whether I want to fully immerse myself in it or not. All I want to convey is that always listen to your gut as I always do the same.
Pray to Your Spirit Guides if You Feel a Presence

I know that they are watching me and trust me it does feel strange. I can not do anything about it except for praying. I keep on praying to my angels and spirit guides to fortify me against any evil. This is because I know that I can not defend myself from them and that I require all the help I can get.

One thing that I really want to convey to my readers is that whenever you encounter such a situation, just leave the place. You don’t have to get into any scuffle with such an entity. There are professionals who have studied these things and know how to respond to any crisis.
Why Do Demons Stay, or What Do They Possess?

Demons usually prefer the living. By living I mean the souls of the people who are still alive and walking on the face of the earth. Whereas a ghost usually goes after the soul of a person who is no more.

Demons are not that easy to find or have an encounter with. They usually seem to reside in places where there is a regular frequency of humans visiting. This does not mean that they are only found in places where humans frequent. I’ve been to certain obsolete places from where you could just feel the negativity and an aura of evil just proliferating. I no longer want to visit such places for the sole reason of the energy they emit.
A demon can be virtually everywhere and anywhere. It has the ability to catch you anywhere. It can be an old home or some dilapidated place with a past.
To Conclude — With My Story

I remember when I was around 12 years old, I was visiting my grandparent’s house in the village. There was an old house on the way to my grandparent’s house. It looked like a normal property and had certainly seen its best days. Whenever I went near the house or was crossing it, I felt a deep sense of chill run through my spine and even a feeling of nausea. I could feel it in my gut, the discomfort.
A few months later, a very respected priest visited my grandparent’s house and confirmed to them that even he felt a sense of strong negative energy when he crossed the old house on his way.

To this day, whenever I think of that house, I feel uneasy. However, there have been instances when I’ve felt the same when I am supposed to check out some haunted location. Whenever I get that feeling, I stop. The reason is that whenever you try to confront a demon, the odds are not in your favour. Of course, there is a higher authority but you can not depend solely on the higher authority to save you. So, I always advise people to not indulge in confrontations and just leave if they find themselves in such uncharted territories.

However, it is rather rare for a person to stumble upon a demon. The chances are really low. But all I want to tell you is that demons exist and they are real. So, whenever you visit a place where you feel gloomy and uneasy, just leave. Now you understand the true meaning of demons and why you should stay away!

posts.title: What are Angels: The Types of Angels
posts.excerpt: What the texts actually say about them — and the several things almost everyone believes that they do not say at all.
posts.dek: Angels are celestial paranormal beings who possess far more intellect and power than us humans. According to some texts, God created them much before he created the earth. They have been around even before the existence of any life.

body.text: Since childhood, we have heard about angels. We have also read about them in books and seen them in movies and plays. All this has created certain perceptions in our minds. We know angels to be supernatural beings that are present to help humanity. Some sources even say that angels are nothing but good people who have passed away and now act as angels. Other stories also suggest that if you do good in your mortal life, then you would also be able to earn your wings after your demise. In this blog, we will learn what angels are and also get a look at the types of angels in the paranormal world.
Do Angels Actually Exist?

To answer the question, yes, different types of angels exist in the paranormal universe. We might not see them or hear them, but they make themselves felt to us by their aura and energy. We as humans are not equipped to be able to see them, but they are always there, watching us.
Then What are Angels Really?

The answer to this question is pretty simple. Angels are celestial paranormal beings who possess far more intellect and power than us humans. Their whole being is pretty much there in heaven and the supernatural world. According to some texts, God created them much before he created the earth. They have been around even before the existence of any life.

According to the Bible, there are millions of types of angels as there is no number specifying their population. The Bible also tells us that all of them have well-defined personas, and they think and feel differently. They also have the privilege to follow any path they deem fit, which can be right or wrong. In addition, they also can converse with one another, but they can not talk to us, humans. They communicate to us through signs and in dreams.
Some Interesting Facts About Angels

items: Angels bow to God only — There is a common misconception among people that an angel only exists to help humans. This, however, is incorrect. An angel only follows what God commands. They are only answerable to him.

There are good and bad angels — Another misconception is that all angels are benevolent. Not all of them are good. The ones who follow a destructive path are condemned to hell. We know them as the devil.

Angels are not people who have died — We often hear people say that if you do good, then after death, you will be reincarnated as an angel. This is not true. They are separate entities created by God. Doing good deeds in life won’t render you an angel after death.
They are not immortal — The Bible says that angels who are not good, that is, are devils, will fall.

Angels help those committed to God — They are always there to help people who are loyal to God and pray to him with a clear heart. They help anyone who is having a tough time and give them strength in testing times.

Guardian Angels also exist — There are specific ones known as the Guardians who look after us in different phases of our lives. They are sent by God himself to look after us and pay heed to our problems and issues.
The angels are always watching us — They are always looking at us and looking out for us as well. Whenever God commands them to intercede in our lives, they follow his orders and help us.
Angels do have feelings — Being supernatural creatures does not render them emotionless. They feel everything we feel. They also experience feelings of happiness, sorrow, longing, and so on.

body.text: To Conclude

The paranormal world is a curious place. Amidst all this curiosity, exists things and beings which are sometimes hard to explain. In all my ghost explorations, I have been saved by my guardian angels numerous times. If not for them and my spirit guides, things could’ve gone downhill. Needless to say, there are stories and these stories will be unfurled in the coming blogs.

posts.title: What is Haunting?
posts.excerpt: The word used loosely for very different things — residual, intelligent, inhuman, possession, shadow — and where each tends to be found.
posts.dek: We use the word ‘haunted’ to declare a place as dangerous because it is frequently visited by a ghost or is resided by a supernatural entity.

body.text: Haunted houses and movies are always an area of interest for most of us. Don’t the movies excite and bamboozle you at the same time? Well, at least it is true for me. In the course of time, you must have often come across the word haunting. But do you know exactly what is the meaning of haunting? So, if you wish to be a paranormal expert or just want some knowledge of the field, it is imperative to understand this aspect. Having said that, let’s begin our journey into understanding hauntings.
Haunting Meaning

Now we will look at the meaning of the word — haunting. We use the word ‘haunted’ to declare a place as dangerous because it is frequently visited by a ghost or is resided by a supernatural entity. People are usually scared of such sites and don’t like to enter such premises. Now, a haunted house might be the place where a person died before, and currently his/her spirit resides, or it can be a place frequented by a spirit or a group.

It is also crucial to understand that you cannot label the spirit as good or evil just because there is a supernatural activity in the house. The spirit might be confused, or it can only be inquisitive, leading people to believe that they are evil. The best person to judge the nature of the spirit is a paranormal researcher. He or she can feel their energy and tell you if that spirit means any harm or not.
Types of Haunting

Yes, hauntings have a wide range of types. Are you surprised? Well, in general, there are two major types of haunting — intelligent and residual. Other than that, there are a few more. Let us look at each in brief.
1. Residual Haunting

A residual haunting is like an imprint of the past. If a stressful event like a murder or a homicide has taken place in the past, then the negative energy in the environment causes an imprint. It is like a playback of the thing that actually took place. In this haunting, you don’t have any interaction with the supernatural entity. It is just something that just keeps on playing like a CD player in the background. Residual hauntings are scary and seldom terrifying to many people out there.
2. Intelligent Hauntings

As per a paranormal expert, intelligent haunting is also known as human haunting and can scare you to your very fibre. In this haunting, a direct interaction between the entity and humans is involved. The spirit is aware of your presence, and you are also mindful that it is around you. In this type of haunting, the spirit makes an effort to let you know about its presence.
3. Inhuman Spirit Haunting

There are spirits or entities that have never lived on the earth as human beings. They have been here since the advent of time and cannot be destroyed as they are energies. Angels, saints, guardian angels are types of inhuman spirits. These beings never had a physical form or shape and are not made of physical matter. They were never born as humans, and we cannot kill them. Inhuman spirits can be good and evil.
4. Possession Haunting

Most of us have seen people getting possessed by spirits in movies. But what does possession signify? Possession is the process by which an inhuman spirit enters the soul of a living human making the human act the way the spirit desires. In this type of haunting, it becomes almost impossible for the person to act according to his wit and actions. It is because the spirit residing inside his soul rules his emotions. The person is entirely under the influence of the spirit and behaves just as the spirit wants.
5. Shadow People

Shadow People is the next type of haunting. In this type, there is no apparent explanation of the events that take place. This type of haunting involves shadowy creatures that are only visible in the form of dark matter. The next type of haunting is a portal type. You can read more about these in detail in the types of hauntings blog if you wish to learn a bit extra about the types.
Places Where Hauntings Occur — Hotspots

Now that we understand the meaning of haunting and its types, it is imperative to know about the places where hauntings are quite rampant. What makes hauntings more apparent is when the redecoration or the revamping of a haunted house is taking place. Just like people, even spirits tend not to like changes in their environment. They feel a sense of connection with the surroundings of the house. When the position of the things in the place is disturbed, they feel uneasiness within themselves, leading them to act erratically and unpredictably. This usually leads to these spirits showing us their presence by either manifesting into something visible or by causing physical disturbances in the house.

Anywhere that anything bad, horrible, or dreadful took place has often seen instances of haunting. As per a paranormal expert, even an abandoned house, hospital or old building serves as a place for haunting activities. Burial grounds are often labelled as hotspots by many paranormal experts.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence a good paranormal investigator should advise his clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Most of your clients may feel desperate due to whatever they are going through. It’s your duty to act responsibly. Guide them through the path of modern science. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.
