body.text: Instances of spiritual possession have been rampant throughout history. Many cultures and traditions have talked about it. In this blog, we will learn more about the historical observations of spirit possession. As you are aware by now we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
Historical Observations of Spirit Possession

There have always been various viewpoints in different cultures regarding the nature of possessing spirits. In certain cases, people believed that they were the spirits of the deceased. While at other instances, the spirits had never been in human form but were instead servants of Satan, or even Satan himself.

Since the twentieth century, we are of the viewpoint that the spirit of the dead is a cause for misery and suffering. With the advancement of science and technology, this has been fundamentally questioned. With biological causes or scientific explanations for everything, the religion aspect has taken a backseat. However, at earlier times, everything was because of spirit possession. Therefore, every religion and culture had its own set of methods for an exorcism.
Observations of Possession in Chinese Culture

Many cultures had very definite ideas about where spirit possession originated, and why they interfered with people’s lives. The Chinese have had a tradition of ancestor worship that goes back more than ten thousand years. In their view, a person goes through many cycles or lifetimes. One must stay on good terms with one’s ancestors because they continue to exist in another world — and, if angered or upset, can return to exert harm in this one.
Observations of Possession in Japanese Culture

The Japanese, too, have practised ancestor worship and believed in earthbound spirit possession. Perhaps this explains the popularity of the rapidly growing exorcistic cult Mahikari, which had four hundred thousand members throughout the world in 1970. Known as the True-Light Supra-Religion, it holds that possessing spirits cause more than eighty per cent of human ailments — physical as well as emotional. Their exorcisms are claimed to be able to restore the possessed person to health and well-being, and thousands are treated daily by these techniques.
Observations of Spirit Possession in Greeks and Romans

Even before Christianity was born, the ancient Greeks and Romans had their own set of beliefs when it came to spirits. They had a well-established notion about the dead and their effects on people. Below are some examples of Greeks and Romans on spirit possession.

items: Homer — “A sick man pining away is one upon whom an evil spirit has gazed.”

Plutarch — “Certain tyrannical demons require for their enjoyment some soul still incarnate; being unable to satisfy their passions in any other way, incite to sedition, lust, wars of conquest, and thus get what they lust for.”
Josephus — “Demons are the spirits of wicked men.”

body.text: Observation of Spirit Possession in Egyptian Culture

The ancient Egyptians also believed that the living were affected by the dead. It was especially true for the spirits of people who were mistreated or dishonoured after death. The ancient tombs are testimonies to their elaborate belief-system that life continues after death. Bodies were mummified so that they could be used again. Also, the inner organs were carefully preserved with herbs and concoctions in burial jars for the same purpose. The tombs were repositories of household articles, food, seeds, animals, and servants to continue their way of life.

Even something as bizarre as the wives being sealed alive was also carried out. Many were of the belief that in this way the wives will accompany the deceased on their journeys into the underworld. Many of my clients have had problems of claustrophobia which can be attributed to these reasons. Like being sealed or buried alive in a tomb. In the sessions with a paranormal investigator in Chennai, India, they recall their horrors. They remember watching with terror as the torches diminished. They also remember experiencing breathing becoming more strained before their deaths from suffocation.
Observation of Spirit Possession in Christianity

There are instances of spirit possession in Christianity as well. Many report that even Jesus cast out spirits on many occasions. I found around twenty-six examples in the Bible of Jesus exorcising spirits. It must be noted that during the early Christian period, the ability to cast out spirits was viewed as a sign of true discipleship. Some examples and accounts from the holy scriptures are given below.
Jesus preached and cast out devils. (Mark 1:39)
A certain man which had devils a long time … Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man … He that was possessed of the devils was healed. (Luke 8:27–33)

Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit … And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child … Jesus rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him. And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead. But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose. (Mark 9:17–27)
Jesus gave his twelve disciples power against unclean spirits, to cast them out. (Matthew 10:1)
Observation of Spirit Possession in Hinduism

As per the Indian scholars, humans have at least seven different “bodies” or “vehicles.” A paranormal investigator in Chennai, India, says that the lowest of the seven bodies is physical. The rest are nonphysical and invisible to ordinary human sight. These bodies correspond to different planes or levels of reality. Not only that, but each of these seven bodies is very fine — vibrating at a higher frequency than the ones below it.

The Indian theory of spirit possession in Hinduism is based on the writings of ancient scholars. As per the writing, there is an entire world which is the astral plane. It exists between the physical and the highest spiritual worlds. It is not a place, but rather an incalculable number of planes, subplanes, and divisions of subplanes. In addition, these planes and sub-planes rise in a gradually ascending scale, as a result of the increasing frequency of vibratory rate.

Paranormal investigators in India believe that the lower astral plane is the home of earthbound spirits. In the higher planes of the astral world reside the spiritually evolved entities that are known as guides, masters or teachers. We also call them spirit guides. It is believed that living human beings often “travel” in their astral bodies to the astral plane during sleep, in certain trance states, and deliberately, by willing a part of themselves to leave the physical body.
How Do the Vedas Describe Death?

To understand spirit possession in Hinduism, we also need to look at how the Vedas describe death. The Vedas hold that death is the sloughing off of the physical body. The individual continues, journeying into higher planes of existence, bringing along memories. After a stay in the astral world, the soul continues to rise to the mental plane, again leaving behind a corpse — the astral shell. Later, the individual goes to a still higher level of the astral plane, awaiting rebirth in a physical body.

This recycling of the true essence of a person from one physical body to another and the doctrine of karma — the law of cause and effect — are essential for spiritual evolution, according to the Vedic system. It is through reincarnation that individuals can purify themselves in order to enter the highest plane and rejoin the Godhead.

So where does spirit possession come in? As per the paranormal investigator in Chennai, India, important cycles of birth and death can be blocked if people are still obsessed with earthly desires. Especially if earthly desires keep them bound at the time of their deaths. In this case, they remain in and are trapped by the vibrations of the physical plane. Therefore, they reside in the lower astral level and areas as close to the earth plane as possible. By staying there, they make futile attempts to satisfy their addictions and desires. While in this lowly state, these earthbound entities cannot make any spiritual progress. They cannot be released from their lower vehicles and rise to higher states. And this is where evil spirit possession comes in.
Observations of Possession in South American Culture

South American culture also talks about spirit possession. We will discuss this through French writer Alan Kardec who has a profound catalytic effect of spiritualism. The mysticism is apparent through his books which were on the immortality of the soul. The book also talked about the nature of spirits and their relationships with men. He claimed his books were dictated to him by spirits of a higher degree, transmitted through mediums.

Mediums have a huge impact when it comes to spirit possession and South America. At one instance in Sao Paulo in 1985, I was lecturing at the First International Congress on Alternative Therapies. During my tour, I got an exclusive look into the Federation of Spiritism of Sao Paulo. It is an organization housed in a large school-like building. Thirty-five hundred mediums, coming from all walks of life — from illiterate servants to lawyers — treat fifteen thousand patients per week, without a fee!

The guide there told me that spirit possession and therapy is such a common thing in Sao Paulo that one out of five inhabitants there is a medium. There are twelve million people living in Sao Paulo! Sao Paulo is no exception; mediumship is rampant in all of Brazil. As a paranormal expert in Chennai, India, this information was quite fascinating for me.
Observations of Possession in British Culture

In 1982, Arthur Guirdham, M.D., a British psychiatrist, reported his findings on spirit possession in a book. The book is called The Psychic Dimensions of Mental Health. The conclusions had their basis on his work of more than forty years. During those forty years, he became of the view that every form of severe mental illness can be attributed to some sort of spirit interference. Deeply committed to healing patients, he believed the usage of electroshock therapy can dislodge stubborn possessing spirits.

Adam Crabtree, a practising therapist and scholar of mesmerism, also works with spirit possession. In Multiple Man: Explorations in Possession and Multiple Personality, he describes his understanding of his patients’ conditions in terms of both possession by earthbound spirits as well as multiple aspects of people’s own personalities. His techniques are more of the persuasive type, as he does not use electroshock.
Observations of Possession in the United States

In the United States, Carl Wickland, M.D., an early Spiritualist psychiatrist, worked for thirty years with severely disturbed clients. He felt as if these clients were under the possession of earthbound entities. His wife, Anna — a trance medium — allowed the possessing spirits to speak through her vocal apparatus. Dr Wickland then conversed with them, in a two-way exchange, and convinced them of their condition. After educating them about the life waiting for them, he persuaded them to leave.

In 1924, he published his book, Thirty Years Among the Dead. It was a classic in the field of therapy related to spirit possession. In it, he outlined his theory of mental illness which was a result of possessing spirits. Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, a Spiritualist scholar, had this to say of him and his book:
I have never met anyone who has such a wide experience of the invisible. No one interested in obsession or the curing of insanity by psychic means should miss this book.
To Wrap it Up

The examples above are enough to portray that people from all cultures around the globe believed in spirit possession. They were of the view that an earthbound entity can possess human beings. It was true for mediums and scholars alike. And everyone had their own way of finding a solution to the problem. Although this does not entirely prove the theory as a paranormal investigator in Chennai, India, I believe it is enough to have a debate. Like reincarnation, life after death, the soul, and many other concepts, spirit possession most probably cannot be proven.

For me, as a paranormal investigator in Chennai, India, working with many people with their own set of problems, I have realized that the issue of proof is not a priority. What matters are the results. Like we say, “To each his own.”

posts.excerpt: Why the gift lands hardest on the young, and what actually helps — mostly explanation, and taking the fear out of it.
posts.dek: When it comes to haunting, children seem to suffer a lot, especially psychic children. Maybe because they are still unaware of their capabilities and how to control them.

body.text: When it comes to haunting, children seem to suffer a lot, especially psychic children. Maybe because they are still unaware of their capabilities and how to control them. Maybe because they are too young to understand and make sense of whatever it is that’s happening around them. In this excerpt, we will look at the haunting of psychic children because of rampant paranormal activity. We will also attempt to understand the reason behind why it happens. Let’s start!
Haunting of Psychic Children

Children seem to unfairly suffer from haunting the most because they haven’t yet learned how to use their psychic energies and set boundaries. In addition, fear makes it even worse. Even I have been a psychic since I was a kid. But at the time, I didn’t know anything about this. Therefore, those voices coming from the closet always gave me chills. No one actually thought that I was saying the truth when I tried to communicate it to them. Then again, it is quite understandable because often the families of these children cannot see a thing. And what they can’t see, they can’t stop. Thus, if you have a psychic in your midst, or you are psychic, know that even though no one can keep all the ghosts away, you can always ask your spirit guide to come in and protect them.

If you are a psychic or have psychic children in your midst, surround them with white light. I have already discussed the importance of the white light and how it can protect you. Perhaps the most important thing is to help the psychic amidst you to understand why is it that the things that are happening are taking place. If it is not your cup of tea, look for a paranormal expert near you who can help in identifying the cause behind the instances taking place. It is always a great idea to contact a medium if you know one.
All Ghosts are Not Bad

The important thing for psychic children is to understand that all ghosts and spirits are not bad. Maybe the one who the child can hear is just your regular lost ghost. The ghost is too lost for his own good to haunt anyone else. Or, it could be residual energy. Therefore, every paranormal activity is not necessarily bad and this is what they need to understand. Once they know most ghosts aren’t bad, it takes a lot of the fear out of their gifts. You, as a parent, sibling or relative, should explain to the clueless child that the ghosts are just people with no physical bodies. This can be tough, yet it’s worse if people refuse to talk about it. It makes them feel like what’s happening is either very bad or very unacceptable, which equates to being super scary.

The crucial aspect of all this is that, for psychic children, the haunting will never stop. Wherever they are, they will attract it knowingly or unknowingly. They have to live it for the rest of their lives. The best way out is to accept and move on. This is exactly what I have done. Nothing can make it go away and it most definitely is not in their heads. Therefore, you must ensure to help if you can or call for help if you cannot.
Haunting of Psychic Children is Mostly Harmless

Let us now consider a scenario. A person X passes on in a car crash or any other accidental death. However, X is not aware that he is dead. It cannot happen because the idea of it happening is unimaginable. Now X is tirelessly trying to reach home, looking for his mother. Several years pass and somehow someone else comes to live in that spot of X’s death. The ghost sees the child and wants to catch his attention so as to get some help. Now, for the ghost, it is pretty normal but for a child, a disturbance that has no source but it is happening all the time can be scary.

Therefore, it is important to help the psychic children to understand the very fact that all ghosts are not harmful. Trust me, it can be a big help. Sure, they are confused and you’re petrified at first. But once you deal with it a time or two, you can not only get rid of their fear, but also help X. Remember, ghosts aren’t really always bad. If there’s no violence occurring, perhaps even try to talk to X yourself by simply saying, “We can’t help you here, and you’re scaring us. Please move on”.

Requesting or making the spirit in the house realize that they are not wanted helps a lot. You do not need a super-power to stop the haunting of psychic children. If you ask them, most of the times, the spirit residing in the house will move on and leave the child alone for good. So if you tell him you can’t help him, there’s no reason for him to stay.

You will notice that the paranormal activity just stopped. Just like paint fumes are a necessary evil for a painter. Ghosts are a necessary evil for psychics. But we do work between worlds. This is particularly true if you or your child also have medium tendencies. Meaning, your psychic or you can not only know that someone in your family is going to pass soon. Since mediums’ gifts deal largely with speaking with the dead, the dead indeed show up to talk.
To Wrap it Up

Once the skills of psychic children are more developed and their boundaries more securely in place, it will be the dead who have made the journey to the other side already who show up, who aren’t nearly as scary. But until they’re more developed, all the dead will seek them out. Just know that if you have “the gift”, you have the paranormal activity and ghosts.

I can honestly say I’d never want to not be able to talk to the dead, but mostly the dead who have already journeyed to the other side and not the dead who are lingering here. And yes, it took me a while to get to this point. But life would feel empty if there wasn’t an occasional visitor. I’m totally serious. If you work with your gifts or help your child work with theirs, it’ll only take a minute before they feel the same way. The only scary thing about most ghosts is your reaction to them.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence a good paranormal investigator should advise his clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Most of your clients may feel desperate due to whatever they are going through. It’s your duty to act responsibly. Guide them through the path of modern science. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.

posts.title: How to Help a Ghost?
posts.excerpt: Passing a soul on is a quiet, ordinary act — asking permission, calling the light, and knowing how to tell whether it worked.
posts.dek: Helping a ghost pass over is not a big task. It is a totally natural and simple process. In fact, what is unnatural is for the soul to remain earthbound as a ghost.

body.text: Now that you have determined that you have a spirit at your home, what do you do? Either you can consult a paranormal investigator or if you wish to help a ghost, there are certain ways. In this excerpt, we will look at how to help a ghost.
How to Help a Ghost?

Whenever a paranormal investigator is helping a client who believes their house is haunted, it’s not just the client that they are helping but also the ghost. At times, the spirits are lost and afraid. Some do not know that they are dead. They are in a place where there is no going back. It is a completely new territory. Therefore, the ghosts need help too. And if they allow me to help, I try my best to help them as well. When I go to help one of my clients who believe they have a ghost, I’m also there to help the ghost, provided the ghost wants me to.

So during an investigation, when I come upon a ghost and begin my dialogue with them, I try to find out why they’re there and if there’s anything I can do to help. In other words, I don’t want to leave them stuck unless they want to remain stuck. Sometimes, even a negative entity can hold a spirit or a ghost down. There are ways to overcome that. Therefore, in an investigation, I also determine if there’s a negative spirit holding them.

I would like to put it forth that helping a ghost pass over is not a big task. It is a totally natural and simple process. In fact, what is unnatural is for the soul to remain earthbound as a ghost. So if you want to understand how to help a ghost, keep reading.
Ask For Their Permission

I have already outlined that a paranormal investigator has to be polite. If a ghost does not want to help you, you won’t be able to help. Therefore, it is important to ask for their permission for you to help them. Once you get their permission, which may be an inclination of some sort, you can help them. What I will do next is I visualize the souls who have passed over and are connected to the one who hasn’t. Since I am a psychic, for me they just show up. It does not matter if you see loved ones or not but when you ask for their help, they will surely make their presence known.

Often times I have seen a face. Sometimes I see many faces. Sometimes when I call upon the loved ones of a spirit or a ghost who needs help, I see a pet, a spirit helper, or just a light. Being a psychic means having visions like a long country road, a grove of trees, a riverbank, a wisp of colour, among others. These are not places where I have been but it is somehow related to the ghost that I am trying to help. However again, even if you see nothing and don’t have a single clue of who or what is there to help this ghost, you can just surround them with the white light.
Ask Spirit Guides to Help the Ghost

What I do next is I call upon their loved ones in spirit, along with any angels, guides, and spirit helpers familiar with them. I ask the spirit guides who also walk in the white light to help. It is very important to call upon those with the white light. Since at times, you may invoke a negative entity if you do not do that. A paranormal investigator asks them to come forward and help them make their transition. I believe it is the higher realms of heaven that open up for them. If you have a group with you, you can all stand in a circle, hold hands, and see yourself encouraging and calling in the white light as it fills the inside of the circle you and your friends have created with energy, light, and love.

Then since I have already taken the permission of the ghost, I ask it to enter the centre of our circle. I, then, visualize that the ghost is transcending upwards into the white light. If I am with a group of people, I ask them to hold hands and then we proceed to help the ghost. Is there something specific that I say? Not exactly. It is something on these lines:

I surround everyone here with the white light. I ask that my gatekeeper step forward to oversee this and protect all who are gathered here. Then I ask that anyone familiar with the soul now trapped in this place, who walk in the white light, come forward. Along with any spirit helpers, guides, and angels also of the white light, and help this soul to transcend out of this place and transition into the next.
How Do You Know That You Were Successful in Helping the Ghost?

Now how do you know that the ghost is gone and you were successful in helping it? Well, if your help worked and they transcended up the white light, you may feel light immediately. As if a big burden was relieved from your shoulders. This is the experience that I had the most. Although the experience may differ for different people. You may smell something altogether pleasant. You may hear bells, chimes, or singing. Your confirmation may range from a small feeling of peace to something quite large. But, you’ll receive confirmation if you remain open to how you receive it. Of course, there won’t be a thank you note that will magically appear out of nowhere and drop at your feet. But you might hear an almost inaudible thank you. Those that love this soul will let you know.
How to Help a Ghost Being Held Down By a Negative Entity?

I have already mentioned that at times, there may be a negative entity holding a ghost down. So, what if a negative or demonic is holding them and you step on their toes? It happens. Usually though, if you have a negative present and you have done nothing but fill the room and space with light, love, and protection — again, the white light is a powerful tool — the most they do is try to growl or scare you off. If you try to help a ghost who has a negative entity attached, they will never step in the circle you create for them. However, finding an actual demonic that is holding them down is quite unlikely. But again, it can happen. There simply are no hard and fast rules in this paranormal world. So, as a paranormal investigator, you must decide. I leave this entirely up to your discretion.

This is simply what I do, and how I do it. It makes me sleep better at night if I can help both my client and the ghost. Yet, I’ll also add that I’ve encountered clients who were so afraid of their ghosts that they didn’t want me to mess with them. In which case I usually leave things as they are, come home, and then I pray that those in the higher realms handle this softly but swiftly. Usually, I think they do. Additionally, I’ve also encountered ghosts that simply refuse to leave. In fact, ghosts are usually quite upfront with me about this and nearly always directly tell me when they have no intention of leaving. In which case, I’ll usually insist.
What if the Owner Does Not Want to Help the Ghost?

Sometimes, I have come across owners who do not want me to help the spirit. At times, people do get attached to the spirits. Obviously, I understand when it’s the owner of a haunted inn who gets regular bookings because of the hauntings. I realize how bad that would be for their business, and their pocketbooks if the hauntings ceased. When I am in the middle of such a scenario, I usually try to connect with the spirits. If they wish to leave, I do the same thing but at my home.

You may also encounter homeowners who say they’ve become so accustomed to the ghost being around. In addition, it will feel like a loss for them if I help the ghost go away. This is very true for children spirits. In such cases, I have met clients who feel sorry for the ghost and/or have taken on some responsibility for it. So, I usually mention to the clients that maybe I should speak with the ghost and see what the ghosts want to do. I know, sounds strange, but if a ghost is stuck, it deserves the right to move on. So I ask. If the ghost wants to stay and the clients want the ghosts to stay, then so be it.

Therefore, it’s always best to check with the owner of the premises you’re at to help a ghost. It’s been my experience that many clients won’t tell you when they’re really attached to their ghosts upfront. And if you work to scat off a ghost your client is somehow attached to, your client will just call them back sometimes. Often, without even realizing they’re doing it, but just with their thought energy. Obviously, there’s no reason to fight that fight.
Don’t Fool Around — Help a Ghost if You Mean to

One thing which has often confused and left me scared, to be honest, is that the ghost knows. If you are at a certain place to help a ghost pass over, they will know it. They somehow read it in your energy field. As such, you’ll get more ghostly encounters and reactions if that’s the case, as there’s definitely more in it for them to make their presence known. However, if you’re going to say you’ll do something for them and then you don’t, you will be repaid in ways you don’t even want to know about. Therefore, if you’re not going to go through with it, don’t say you are.

But if you are, offer it up and you’ll get more responses than probably any other paranormal investigator around. However, if you honestly try to help a ghost transition but are unsuccessful for any reason, it won’t be a problem. Since you put up an honest effort, so it’s a no harm no foul situation. I simply know that I’ve never had one go south. It always works. Yet, as I’ve said like a thousand times already, I can’t guarantee anything. Hence, use your own discretion and comfort level to guide you. If you’re a paranormal investigator with less experience, it is better to give yourself a year or so before you approach this.

As I mentioned earlier, when the clients are too afraid for you to mess with the ghost, you can still help. Just wait until you get home and visualize the ghost, the circle, and ask that the white light, along with their guides and loved ones, come in to help them transition. It’s a very neutral way to approach this problem. And it works. After all, praying for someone, or even just asking in sincerity for help for him or her, is energy.
Are There Any After-Effects If You Help a Ghost?

Ghosts are energy. So you’re sending positive and caring energy to them that will do nothing but help them. Although at this point, it is important that you realize that if there is a negative attached to that ghost, the chances of you hearing from that negative later on is not dim. Having said that, if you know how to call upon your spirit guides to protect you, there is nothing to worry about. You just need to know when to ask for help. And you must ask for help if the need arises.

Obviously, they like holding any energy they can for their own use, even if that’s ghost energy. It is what they do after all. Thus, they may haunt you in real life. They may come to you in your dreams — nightmares really. They can do this in any way they can muster up the energy to do it. So again, it’s your call. It happens to me all the time. I have nightmares. But since I’ve been so exposed to the negative, most of the fear of it has sort of worn off. Sure, I’m not going to stand and purposely kick them in the shins. However, I know if need be, my helpers and I can hold our own. Mainly because I know that the white light always beats dark.

Negative entities will always try to test you. They will make it tough. But you don’t have to get scared and disheartened; that is the most important thing. So pick your battles wisely. The only thing I feel I should caution you about on this topic is releasing a good ghost that was holding the negative ghost or entity at bay for the homeowner. Or even, one being held against their own will. Yep, it happens. If the ghost doesn’t tell you about it, you’re not going to know it’s happening until it does.
Ask the Ghost Why They Have Not Left

The last piece of advice that I would like to give is to ask the ghost why they haven’t left. Try to understand the situation. Usually, if a ghost is staying to protect the homeowner, they’ll tell you. Because either they don’t want to leave yet, or they’re afraid to leave. In those situations, if you want to help, you have to dig into the type of negative you’re dealing with. Usually, like nine times out of ten, it’s a negative ghost, which usually will pass too, in the same aforementioned way, should you take his friend away first, and then offer to do the same for them.

Seriously, it’s fear that often keeps a negative ghost hanging around. Erase the fear, take their prisoners, and they’ll often give up the fight. But when the question of an inhuman entity or a demon arises, I suggest that you keep your hands off of it. It is no joke. And it most certainly is not the task of a year-old paranormal investigator. Do not take that aspect of the paranormal lightly. That is one paranormal thing you do not want to mess with. So let it be and contact a paranormal investigator or someone else who specializes in it.

posts.title: Concept of Resurrection and Judgement Day
posts.excerpt: Rising from the grave, and the reckoning that follows — how four traditions describe the same passage, and where they part.
posts.dek: The process of reward or punishment along with judgement by God is the tenets of Mohammedanism, Christianity and Zoroastrianism.

body.text: Resurrection is rising again from the dead, as was in the case of Christ. People of the Christian faith believe this. The process of reward or punishment along with judgement by God is the tenets of Mohammedanism, Christianity and Zoroastrianism. Let’s understand more about the concept of Resurrection and Judgement Day.
The Jews initiated the concept of resurrection which to date continues with the belief systems of Christians and Mohammedans. The Jews themselves borrowed it from the faith of Zoroastrianism.
The general view, however, is the soul will rise again from the grave. One may inquire how will human anatomy, which decomposes, rise again? Let’s understand this.
Islamic Faith — Concept of Resurrection

But according to the Islamic faith, a person’s body was entirely consumed by the earth, except the bone called Al Ajib or the coccygeus or rump bone. It was the first-formed of the human body. It will likewise stay uncorrupted until the last day as a seed from which the whole will reform anew.
Mohammed stated that God would send a forty-day rain, covering the earth to a considerable height and the bodies to sprout forth like plants.
The Jews opine of a similar concept of the bone Luz. However, they say that the body will sprout by a dew impregnating the dust of the earth.
The Zend Avesta refers to philosophical questions on the resurrection.
How will the body that the wind has taken away and waves have swallowed recreate? How will the revival of the dead happen?

Answered Ormuzd: “Corn laid in the ground grows and comes to life: when I have given the veins of the tree according to their types: when I have given a child to the mother, when I have invented the clouds which take the water from the earth and send it down as rain.”

When God can create all these, would resurrection not be possible by the almighty? “If the seed of wheat buried naked in earth springs up as multiple blades, is it not possible for the virtuous to rise again?”
Resurrection, however, is possible when the following signs precede it according to the Islamic faith:

items: The sun rising in the west instead of east
Dajjal, the false messiah and deceiver of most curious appearance will preach Islam in Arabic speech
The sound of the trumpet called Sur will be audible three times

body.text: Judgement Day — Views of Different Religious Faiths

The Islamic faith believes that once the soul departs the body, it has to wait for interrogation with Mohammed, the prophet. Every part of the soul will be questioned and made to confess for all the sins committed. A bridge called Al Sirat has to be crossed.
A record is made and kept for all the actions of the past life. This is similar to Lord Yama and Chitragupta of the Hindu faith.
In Christianity angel Gabriel will hold a balance that weighs the evil and good deeds of the individual and accordingly, the soul goes to either heaven or hell.

According to Zoroastrianism, the soul has to interact with two angels named Mehr and Sarush on the day of judgement. The souls will be able to cross the Chinavat bridge to meet the preceptor Ahuramazda only after their investigation.

The Hindus speak of Vaitarani, a river, as mentioned in the Garuda Purana that lies between the earth and the realm of Yama, Hindu god of death, and purifies one’s sins. Furthermore, while the righteous see it filled with nectar-like water, the sinful see it filled with blood. Souls have to cross this river after death.

posts.title: Signs of Possession: What Are the Signs to Look For?
posts.excerpt: Appetites, relationships and habits that change without reason — the signs that recur across cases, and the ordinary explanations that come first.
posts.dek: Possession comes with its own signs. The negative aspects seem to outweigh the positive by a considerable margin. As paranormal experts in Chennai, India we have seen possessions changing people in ways that completely transform them.

body.text: Possession comes with its own signs. The negative aspects seem to outweigh the positive by a considerable margin. As paranormal experts in Chennai, India we have seen possessions changing people in ways that completely transform them. Starting to behave differently is one such sign of possession. People start indulging in things they hated or did not do before getting possessed. In this excerpt, we will talk about the signs of possession including demonic possession, and understand it better. As you are aware by now we are a team of paranormal consultants and investigators in Chennai, India under the leadership of Mr Praveen Saanker.
Signs of Possession – Alcohol and Drug Dependency

Apart from depression, drug and alcohol addiction are a major consequence of spirit possession. When the spirit has control over you, the behaviour transforms and it has total or partial control over you. It manipulates your brain into indulging in drugs or alcohol. However, it is very important to understand here is that the spirits do this to quench their thirst and end up harming you and your body. When a person is constantly under the influence of such vices, then the aura around him becomes very fragile. This allows a negative entity to easily enter your body and have full control. There is also a danger of multiple entries if a person’s aura is weak.

The spirit influences a person in such a way that the scope of reinvention is also nullified. Another of the signs of demonic possession. The person becomes hostile when people try to help him and they don’t want to get help. Behaviour also undergoes a drastic change within a person. I once had a client who never did drugs, not even in college. But, after visiting a bar with friends one night, started smoking marijuana. His family told me that he never liked or did drugs but now got hooked on them. It took me four sessions for the spirit to actually let go of him. In most cases, it is very difficult to make the spirit leave the host’s body. Most addictive spirits are of a very rigid nature and they refuse to respond to anything.
Why is it Dangerous?

Alcoholism signs of possession are very dangerous because patients tend to stop getting help and lose themselves to addiction. Many people lose their lives due to consuming alcohol beyond their limits and over a longer span of time. As far as drugs go, dependence destroys a person’s career. It also affects their relationships and ends up destroying their family lives. People go through divorces and end up becoming even more miserable. The depression increases and so does the drug intake. The increase in drug intake can also result in a drug overdose. A drug overdose can harm a person’s organs and can also kill him.
An Example of a Client I Worked With

I will now narrate the story of one of my clients who was exhibiting signs of spirit possession. One of my very own clients, let us call him “patient Y” for privacy reasons, escaped death by a very narrow margin. So patient Y was a trader in his mid-forties. He came to me for help because he had a drinking problem. He told me that he developed a drinking problem about six years ago after he got operated on for a kidney stone. When I put him under hypnosis, it was evident that he was possessed by a spirit who had a very tough life. The spirit also indicated that he lost a loved one that made him very sad. His last resort to forget the loss was to start drinking.

After a few days, I got a call from client Y asking for an immediate appointment. When we met, he looked absolutely dreadful. He seemed weak, his eyes were all swollen and even his clothes looked very unclean. He sat down and told me that he had a very strange night. Last night he slept peacefully but when he woke up, he saw the bottle of scotch open and there was no liquor left in it. Further, he said that he remembered that the bottle was full when he went to sleep and now it has gone. He told me that he is fully sure that he was not the one who drank the liquor. Client Y was single so no one was there with him and his family lived in Agra.
When You Are Not Under Your Control

He also saw that there was a pack of sleeping pills in which two pills were missing. Y told me that he feels lucky enough to not consume the pills as he would have had serious health issues if he had done so. He then saw the calendar in my chamber and saw that the date was the 6th of February. His face became pale. He told me that he thought it was the 5th of February as he remembers going to sleep on the 4th night. Y slept for one full day and two nights. I told him that he was very lucky to survive as consumption of any more pills would have been fatal. After a successful depossession, the spirit left as we were able to convince him to leave.
Signs of Possession – Smoking Habits

Smoking or nicotine addiction is not a very dangerous effect of possession as it does not change how you think or behave. However, smoking does have long-term effects on your body and can cause major health issues in the longer run. I have been involved with patients who are suffering from lung cancer but still can’t give up smoking.

People say that the urge to smoke is more than just a fixation. It drives you. Your fingers want to hold the cigarette and one cannot stop unless they bump one in the mouth. Another thing that needs to be addressed here is that the spirit does not care about the person it has possessed. It does not care if the person has cancer or if he has health problems. The spirit wants what it wants. After a successful depossession, most of the patients no longer have the urge to smoke.
Signs of Possession – Obesity and Weight Issues

Obesity is one of the most common problems that therapists face. By therapists, I mean both physical and psychological. As far as obesity goes, it is related to the person being overweight and brings a lot of problems with itself. Now, I will not go on to say that all the people with obesity have been possessed or they are obese because some spirit has taken over their body. But, there have been several cases where people have been possessed and it has led them to consume food materials in such a way that they gain a lot of weight.

Obesity is a big issue as it can damage a person’s health as per paranormal experts in Chennai, India. Heart and blood pressure issues are the most common aspects of obesity. Young kids suffer from diabetes due to this and it affects their life in more than one way. I have had patients who could not give up on unhealthy food due to being possessed by an entity. The spirits not only make people eat a lot but also makes people shy away from doing exercise. These kinds of possessions usually arise after a person is hospitalized for some treatment or they have recently lost someone very close to them.
Another Example of a Client That I Worked With

Aman, a young man in his mid-thirties, was very happy as his long-term obsession with sweets was alleviated after a session with me. He was very happy as he could now follow a proper weight loss regime. When I met him afterwards, he told me that he was no longer interested in consuming sweets.

Another client of mine said that one morning, she thought that it was high time for her to have a proper diet plan. She was looking to get committed to eating only good foods as she wanted to get back in shape. She said that she heard a voice in her head say “I won’t let you stop eating”. The spirit was inside her for a very long time and was dictating terms. She could not stop consuming junk even if she wanted to.

The client also expressed that she had started to loathe herself every time she ate something dirty. However, the spirit went after we conducted a successful depossession. The woman no longer had the urge to cram junk.
Signs of Possession – Relationship Issues

People experience issues in relationships when it comes to possession. A possessed person acts and behaves differently than he used to as per a paranormal expert in Chennai, India. The voice inside him dictates the terms and he no longer behaves like himself. This is due to the involvement of another entity.

One of my patients, a young woman in her mid-twenties, got married to her boyfriend, whom she knew for the last 3 years. However, after marriage things changed. The woman who was all in love with the guy started to behave differently. She started to get violent and hurled abuses even after small disagreements.

The husband could not take it anymore and filed for divorce. He said that it was too much for him and could not understand why the woman who loved him so much became so violent with him. Thanks to the almighty that the guy found out about me and brought his wife for an appointment. After successful depossession, we found out that the woman was possessed by the spirit of a woman who was also abused by her husband and died by suicide. This was a classic case of a vengeful spirit trying to destroy someone else’s life because it could not have one of its own.
Signs of Possession – Sexual Problems

A lot of spirits out there were old when they passed away. Therefore, sexual problems too could be signs of spirit possession. With age, comes a plethora of mental and physical problems. People start to have a diminished sexual drive with age. Sexual problems are something these spirits bring with them when they enter a person’s body. Young people start having sexual dysfunctions after they get possessed by a spirit. There are instances when the spirit stops a person from even engaging in intercourse.

In ancient times some people even are of the belief that homosexuality is a case of possession. When a spirit of the opposite sex takes control of a human being then people start to engage in sexual activity involving the same sex. However, I find this inference weak as it is highly improbable that both the parties are under possession at the same time of having sexual intercourse.
Another Example of One of My Clients

One of my clients, a man in his mid-thirties, was experiencing sexual problems after he was under treatment for a broken wrist in the hospital. When the man returned from the hospital, he started to have sexual problems which he did not have before. After going through his prescription, I found out that he was not given any kind of steroids during treatment. Hence, the chances of developing a reaction were negated. During the next few sessions, we figured out that he was possessed by an elderly man, in his eighties, who died due to heart failure in the same hospital in which my patient was admitted. The spirit left after some convincing.

When the man came to me for his second appointment, he seemed very happy. He told me that he was very happy as he felt a great change in himself. There were no problems and he was feeling great returning to his normal. Even I felt a sense of happiness as I was able to help a young man live his life to the fullest. As paranormal investigators, all we seek is satisfaction in what we do and making our clients happy.

There have been instances where I was working with clients who were under the possession of spirits of the opposite sex. And it made them act and behave in a way that was really embarrassing for them and their family. Depossession helped many and they were free from most of their problems.
To Wrap it Up

Lastly, these cases were some of the cases that I chose from the list of clients that I had worked with. I am sure that the examples have thrown more light on the signs of possession. I am not saying that everyone with addiction or sexual problems is under possession. Problems can also arise due to just mental issues. A person can also get depressed due to some other reason and then start indulging in drugs or alcohol.

Some people do alcohol and drugs just for recreational purposes and they don’t fall into the category of possessed people. I am talking about extreme cases here. I am talking about the people who have detested these vices their entire lives and then start doing them without any motive or reason. Their aim is to destroy themselves physically and mentally by submitting themselves to drugs and liquor.

When you experience biological or emotional disturbances, please consult a medical practitioner first. After all, paranormal is all about negating every single scientific possibility first. Remember you have to remain a healthy sceptic if you want to be a paranormal investigator. I have met so many clients who were suffering from personality disorders, other addictive issues claiming to have possession issues and 99% of them did not have any possession issues.
My advice to you

Please remember that any physical or emotional discomforts a person experiences can mostly be due to various diseases or emotional conditions he or she is going through. I have seen that majority of cases do not involve paranormal activity of any kind. Paranormal events are extremely rare occurrences. Hence your problems should be first brought to the notice of a qualified medical practitioner. I have often seen that the line between borderline personality disorders or other psychiatric disorders and “spirit possession” is thin. Hence a good paranormal investigator should advise his clients that professional medical care is the first solution or remedy for any physical or emotional discomfort.

Remember, you need to be a sceptic first to develop into a paranormal investigator. You need to rule out every single scientific possibility that is known to mankind to identify anything that is paranormal. Hence travel through the path of modern science, explore and unravel all facts using data and what cannot be explained through science is what we need to explore more through the paranormal arena. Most of your clients may feel desperate due to whatever they are going through. It’s your duty to act responsibly. Guide them through the path of modern science. Refrain from being a doctor or healer. There are qualified medical practitioners out there who can do their job well. Avoid any forms of advice on religious or cultural rituals or for that matter any ritualistic practices.

posts.excerpt: The aura as an immune system — how it is breached, who is most exposed, and the difference between being taken and inviting it.
posts.dek: We have tried to understand numerous things about possession in the previous articles. The information was derived from the records of the people who were possessed formerly. I hope that I have been able to clear a lot of your doubts and maybe taught you something new.

body.text: We have tried to understand numerous things about possession in the previous articles. The information was derived from the records of the people who were possessed formerly. I hope that I have been able to clear a lot of your doubts and maybe taught you something new. But, still, there are some questions about ghost entry that need to be addressed properly by a paranormal expert. The most important of them all is, “what are my options when I get possessed?”.
Ghost Entry: How to Protect Yourself From Possession?

The aura around us protects us from being a soft target and getting possessed easily. An aura vibrating at a fast frequency does not let the spirit enter the body of the person. It acts as a barrier between us and the entities. So, if your aura is vibrating at the rate of 2000 vibrations per second then only the beings that are vibrating at the rate of more than 2000 vibrations per second can get in. On the other hand, if the vibrations of your aura drop to 1000 per second then, the beings whose vibrations are less than 1000 can easily get inside your aura. Hence, we can see that the drop in vibrations results in the breach of a person’s aura and can lead to possession.

One can also think of it like this — The aura is like the immune system of the spiritual dimension of your body. Just like when your immune system is damaged, it exposes your body to a wide variety of diseases. When the aura is damaged, it gives access to spirits that wander the earth to enter your body and violate you.

During my own research, I have found out that there exist two chief reasons as to why possession takes place in the first place. There are instances in which people invite spirits to enter into their body and then there are times when one gets unwillingly possessed. This happens without the knowledge or the consent of the patient.
Unwilling Possession and Ghost Entry

I am of the firm belief that a person is a spirit inside the physical form known as the body. When we die, the spirit leaves the body just like we discard old clothes once they are worn out. The body loses everything and becomes unconscious once the spirit leaves it. So what I mean to say is that even when the person is briefly knocked out or unconscious then it opens doors for the spirit to go out.

I am not saying people die when they become unconscious but, it is like an opportunity for the soul to get out. Another point that I want to raise is that when we are unconscious or out of control due to some accident, excessive drinking, and doing drugs then we make ourselves open to possession.

Take for example – Anaesthesia is used in hospitals to operate or perform surgery upon the patients. When the patient becomes unconscious, then the surgeons perform the surgery. But why it is like this? This is solely because anaesthesia forces a person out of his physical form thus negating the chances of any hurt being caused to him during the medical procedure.

What I have read is that a person remains above his body when there is a medical procedure being performed on him. They see everything and are fully detached from the outcome. Success or failure, they remain the same, unfazed. As the anaesthesia loses its strength after a point of time then, the body is again ready for the soul to host it.
The Soft Targets of Unwilling Possession

What I’ve also noticed is that people who are nurses, hospital staff, doctors, and the people who work in a hospital are more often the soft targets for possession and ghost entry. This due to the fact that they work in a place where people with weak auras come for treatment and also it is a place where people lose life constantly.

If a person had the vision to see the spirits then most people would be amazed to see the number of spirits in a hospital. Therefore, paranormal experts believe that hospitals are a hotspot for ghost entry. This is because, in a hospital, people often die in a state of confusion due to sudden death or dying under the influence of anaesthesia or other drugs used for medical purposes. They are not able to understand the reason for their death or the fact that they have died. So, there are multiple instances of these confused souls entering the body of the people who take care of them in the hospital.
Storytime…

One such story of ghost entry is of a patient who came to me. I cannot give out his name for privacy reasons and also because he was an alcoholic. He was possessed by a spirit who had died due to a heart attack in the hospital. The spirit of that person became very agitated about what had happened to him and he only thought of getting back to his body. He also needed to consume alcohol. Then he saw my patient who used to work in the hospital and possessed him. My patient started to constantly visit bars and drink. He also started to have a strained relationship with his wife due to excessive drinking. The obsession with alcohol nearly killed him.

The spirits that I am talking about are those who roam in hospitals or health centres. These are the ones who lookout for people with weak auras so that they can cling to them. When a person is suffering from a serious disease or illness, it weakens their aura and they become vulnerable to outer attack. Therefore, they become susceptible to ghost entry as per a paranormal expert. This issue is more rampant in children who can get easily dominated by spirits. Also, when a person is being constantly possessed by a spirit, his aura becomes so weak that it can be easily possessed by any spirit.
Addiction and Ghost Entry Goes Like Gin and Tonic

The activities that put people at risk of being possessed are drugs and excessive alcohol. Therefore, ghost entry is very often seen in addicts as per a paranormal expert. I have seen people who just tried to have fun with recreational drugs facing issues resulting in possession for several years.

There are many of my patients who have indulged in drug abuse and it resulted in them getting possessed. In most of the cases, there was an involvement of multiple spirits who were drug addicts themselves in their former lives. These spirits instead of passing on to the other realm chose to cling on to other people and quench their thirst.

Also, negative emotions such as sadness, grief, and erratic behaviour also harm the aura around you. This again makes you prone to ghost entry. It also weakens the protection offered by your aura. Another very important factor that results in the breach of a person’s aura is fatigue. Fatigue and depletion of energy are major causes of the breach of the aura of a person. The spirits lookout for this and pronounce it when a person is at his weakest.
Death of Someone Close Often Creates Emotional Disturbance Thereby Attracting Spirits

The death of a member of the family or a loved one also creates a certain type of vulnerability among the family or the friends of the departed. This again results in ghost entry. These people are exposed in the hospitals where the patient is admitted and also the crematorium where his mortal remains are finally destroyed. There is a high chance of them getting possessed as both places are a melting pot of a wide variety of spirits and entities.

I remember the case of a newly married couple in Bangalore. The husband died in a car crash and the wife grieved excessively after his demise. She started to write letters to her husband which was when ghost entry took place. After a point in time, she started having issues related to her mental and physical health. When she came to me for a session, it was pretty evident that she was possessed by her own husband as she was not able to let go of him.

I have also seen cases where dead parents of my patients were there with them since their death. They were not ready to leave as they wanted to be with their children and also were not ready to listen to what I had to say. So in most of the cases, the victims were unwilling to get possessed. They were also unaware of the fact that they have been possessed. However, there is another group of people who want to get possessed and open themselves to outer interferences by spirits.
Willing Possession and Ghost Entry

In this type of possession, people open themselves to outer spirits and are okay with themselves getting possessed by an entity. There have been numerous cases of artists and authors who claim that their art is the result of them getting possessed. Another thing that these people say is that the possession by the spirits help them to understand the aspects of the afterlife and death in a better way. This enables them to have a birds-eye view of human life and death which then translates into their art. Artists also claim that they also want to understand and decode the messages sent by the outer forces so that they can have a higher level of maturity than the average Joe.

The Ouija board also owes its popularity to these people for ghost entry as per a paranormal expert. People who are willing to establish communication with the spirits sit around this board. This board has alphabets and numbers that are engraved in them. It also has a yes and no option. The board has a wooden arrow on which the participants place their index fingers. When they are able to establish a connection with the help of a medium then, the arrow moves depending upon what question is thrown at the spirit. This to me is a really exciting process but it can be harmful if a naive person or a novice is indulging in the act.
Automatic Writing and Ghost Entry

Another way that helps people to connect with spirits is called automatic writing. It is a fairly simple way to talk to the spirits as it only features a pen and paper. In this process, people use their hands as a medium for the spirit. Then questions are asked and if the spirit is able to reply then it replies by writing the answer. This process, however, is dangerous as it might attract the wrong spirit and who can cause harm to the medium.
Storytime…

A patient of mine once told me about a very scary episode from her past. She was trying to learn to write from a medium and was automatically receiving messages from different spirits. She was jotting everything down as the conversations were rather interesting. One night she woke up to see that her hand was automatically writing something in the air. She was unable to gain control over the movement of her hand. After roughly five horrifying long minutes the shaking stopped. However, her teacher continued to get messages and lyrics in foreign languages which led to violent shaking that just did not stop. She ended up getting hospitalized. Therefore, what I want to say is that you can never be sure about such things so it is very important to protect yourself at all times.

Another experience of ghost entry is of a man who got too scared and was losing his mind. He called many doctors and complained that he felt very anxious and panicky as the spirit was constantly pushing him to write. Also, he could not keep control. He was exhausted by the constant pressure of the spirit to keep on writing. The doctors told his family to take him to a mental institution where he would be treated after a thorough diagnosis. I don’t know what happened to him. I hope he got well.
Ghost Entry and Possession is Not Always a Certainty

Hence, opening yourself to a spirit does not guarantee possession. There is no surety that one will get possessed. The thing is that it opens you to the danger of getting possessed. The main issue with this is that sometimes, you don’t know who is inside you. It may be an unknown spirit that has taken control of your body.

I am sure that most of you heard about the Hollywood movie “The Exorcist.” In the movie, the girl got possessed by a demon who turned her life into a living hell. Her case of ghost entry was quite sad as per a paranormal expert. She was like a zombie, neither alive nor dead. The priest who tried to perform an exorcism on her also lost his life during the course of the same. I am citing this example to tell you there a lot of exorcists out there have lost their lives. So, you can imagine how dangerous it can be.
Demonic Possession

Now, since you know about the worst aspects of ghost entry and demonic possession, I will tell you a story in which the consequences were not so hyper. Rani, a young girl seemed to have been under the control of some entity. She came to me and made it pretty clear to me that she did not need my help. She told me that she did not hear the voices anymore. The girl was short and obese. She told me her story. She made use of ouija boards and tarot cards to establish a connection with spirits. It was all done for recreational purposes and she was with her friends while doing so. After she went back home, she started to hear voices in her head. She was perplexed and confused.

Thankfully, the spirits responsible for ghost entry were benevolent and they were just trying to communicate. Rani became comfortable with them after some time and even asked them questions about her life and friends. They would give her answers in the form of writing. She thought that the spirits were her friends as they made her comfortable and did not disturb her in any way. After a point of time, she started to notice changes in the behaviour of the spirits. She started to notice that the voices she heard now were different from what she heard earlier. The benevolent spirits had gone.
The Voices Were Intense

The voices in her head became more resolute and intense. This leads her to drop out of college and she even ended up losing her friends. She told them to let go of her multiple times but the new set of entities refused to go. She was very disturbed and was having a very hard time. There were physical symptoms attached to it this time. Vomiting and suffering from exhaustion became rampant. Her parents got very worried and took her to a psychiatrist who told them that she was suffering from schizophrenia.

Therapy for her ghost entry began and she stayed in a special unit for patients like her. After a year of treatment and medication, she was able to somehow return to her college. She further said that she did not like the fact that her parents took away her ouija board. Also, she was under the treatment of her psychiatrist and was reluctant to continue her treatment.
Seance and Ghost Entry

Another very common practice is called a seance. In this, a group of people sit in a circle and basically call out the spirit. They try and establish a connection with the spirits by asking them to show up. There have been cases of teenagers performing a seance and suddenly some spirit manifested which terribly scared the teenagers. The danger lies in the fact that if someone has a weaker aura around him/her then, they might be exposed to the spirit they are calling out. This is dangerous because there is no guarantee that the spirit is benevolent and means no harm.

We saw how the ouija board, automatic writing, and seances are used as tools by people who want to talk to spirits. A paranormal expert believes that this often results in ghost entry since people do not know how to protect themselves. We also saw how these methods are used to open oneself to spirits. Also, we discussed how some people get unwillingly possessed without knowing anything. I have tried to draw a line between the two chief types of possession. However, the line between the two is grey. At least I think so!
Some People Willing to Open Themselves

Some people just want to contact the spirits to help them with loneliness and do it in an unplanned manner. They open themselves for the ghost entry to happen but all is done in an unplanned way. This is the story of Mansi. It was the beginning of her session, she released a few spirits. After some days, she told me that she actually called the spirits to help her as she was going through some stuff. She even confessed that she was aware of all the problems related to it. She further said that there were so many entities in her that every decision of her was discussed and deliberated by the group of residing entities.

However, under hypnosis, it was clear that these entities were indeed spirits. I have a belief that the majority of my clients who were under the control of multiple spirits, and who suffered ghost entry between their therapy sessions were mediums. These people did not indulge in drugs or liquor. But their aura was so weak that even if they ate something from a hotel, their aura developed a deficit leading them to get possessed. So, even if they went to the hospital to visit someone, they ended up getting possessed.
Psychics are Prone to Possession

The reason why some people are more psychic than others is that they have an inherent ability to get access to their own minds. Most people do not have the capability to get into their subconscious minds and make use of it. Even if they know then they cannot make proper use of it. I am also of the belief that most of us know about each other’s subconscious minds. But, the information we get is not something that can get transferred to our conscious mind. That’s why some people have a gut feeling or what some people also call the sixth sense.

A psychic has the ability to tap into his inner mind as per a paranormal expert. This also acts as a hindrance for many as it leaves a lot of them open to ghost entry and possession. My data also points out the fact that sensitive people are more vulnerable to getting possessed. I think that it is due to the weakened layers between their conscious and subconscious mind. It is due to this that negativity is able to seep through the layers between their conscious and subconscious minds. Emotional issues, fears, memories, and traumas also result in the weakening of their aura. Also, their desire to help others, even entities cause possession in some instances. This danger is with them since their very childhood.

Some of my clients who were interested in the metaphysical aspects of the universe did continue with their pursuit of finding out more about them. I have always advised against doing so because it’s never safe and causes ghost entry. They always picked up spirits and then came to me for sessions and to strengthen their aura.
To Wrap it Up

Several of my colleagues from the US and Europe also say that they too have had similar experiences with their clients. But, they were able to help people because of their training. In a country like India, it is very difficult to find a legitimate person who will help you if you face such a problem let alone the training. How to Talk to a Ghost?

There is a correct way to talk to a ghost. You have to be polite. The important thing to remember is not to provoke. In many paranormal shows, you may have seen the paranormal investigators provoking the ghosts. This is a completely wrong thing to do. Being respectful is the key. Understanding that they too were human and treating them in the correct way is essential. Begin by asking simple but direct questions without using any provocation. We have already discussed the kind of questions to ask to talk to ghosts in previous blogs. I find that when you ask them politely and there’s a ghost there who requires help or guidance, they’re going to get something through to me. However, sometimes you may sense more than you hear.

It might take you a while to talk to a ghost or hear them since they have to compile enough energy. It is very tough to do anything in relatively short order. So give them some time to reply. Plus, they’re trying to figure you out to talk to you as well. In other words, before they’re going to waste a lot of their time and energy to get through to you, they want to make sure there’s something in it for them. So while the grumpier ghosts want to scare you away and usually begin quickly by making some rather aggressive sounds, the ‘normal’ spirits are going to evaluate whether you’re worth the effort it takes to get through.
Be Patient

Again, the important thing is to be a little patient if you wish to talk to a ghost. Take batteries or plugin some electronics to give them an energy boost, and listen. Even better, take in a ghost box, white noise machine, KII Meters, or any machine they can manipulate. We have already talked about the type of ghost hunting equipment you may require. That way, it will be easier for them to communicate with you. Since it requires far less energy on their part, their responses will be bolder and quicker.

The types of questions that you wish to ask depending upon the place where the paranormal investigation is going on. We should always remember that the spirit we are talking to was once a human and, so we should communicate with the same respect. Don’t just ask anything for the sake of it. Ask relevant and reasonable questions and repeat them several times throughout the vigil. Frame polite questions and keep in mind that the spirit has emotional energy.

Explain why you are here if you wish to talk to a ghost in the paranormal investigation. Ask questions to which they can easily give one or two-word answers. Below are some great electronic voice phenomena or EVP Questions that you can ask depending upon the history of the place:

items: Is there anyone here that would like to talk to us?
Can you tell us your name, please?

Why are you here?
Are you alone?
How many of you are here?
Are there any children here?
Is there anyone with you?
What are their names?

body.text: So on and so forth!

posts.title: Spirit Haunting: Why Spirits Remain Among Us?
posts.excerpt: Attachment, unfinished business, or simple confusion about one’s own state — the reasons are rarely dramatic.
posts.dek: Often during sessions with my clients, through hypnosis, I have come across various reasons for why the spirits chose to remain.
